## Grid

### Basic

The [Carbon grid system](https://carbondesignsystem.com/elements/2x-grid/overview/) uses a responsive column structure where the total number of columns changes based on screen size. Column spans are relative to the total columns at each breakpoint -- to create a full-width column, use `sm={4} md={8} lg={16}` instead of the same value across all breakpoints.

Create a basic grid layout with equal-width columns.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Row>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

| Breakpoint          | Viewport width   | Columns |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | ------- |
| **Small (`sm`)**    | 0-671px          | 4       |
| **Medium (`md`)**   | 672-1055px       | 8       |
| **Large (`lg`)**    | 1056-1311px      | 16      |
| **X-Large (`xlg`)** | 1312-1583px      | 16      |
| **Max (`max`)**     | 1584px and above | 16      |

### Variants

Adjust grid width and column spacing.

#### Full width

Use the full-width grid variant for layouts that span the entire viewport width. This removes the default max-width constraint.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid fullWidth>
  <Row>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

#### Narrow

Create a more compact grid layout using the narrow variant. This reduces the spacing between columns.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid narrow>
  <Row>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

#### Condensed

Use the condensed variant for even tighter spacing between columns. This is ideal for dense data displays.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid condensed>
  <Row>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
    <Column>Column</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

#### Per-row

`condensed`, `narrow`, `noGutter`, and `padding` are also available directly on `Row`, so you can mix densities within a single grid instead of applying a variant to every row.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Row condensed>
    <Column>Condensed row</Column>
    <Column>Condensed row</Column>
  </Row>
  <Row>
    <Column>Default row</Column>
    <Column>Default row</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

### Columns

Build responsive layouts by setting a different column width per breakpoint. Each breakpoint has a different total column count, so scale spans proportionally.

#### Full width column

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Column sm={4} md={8} lg={16} />
```

#### Half width (50/50 split)

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Column sm={2} md={4} lg={8} />
<Column sm={2} md={4} lg={8} />
```

#### Two-thirds / one-third split

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Column sm={4} md={6} lg={11} />
<Column sm={4} md={2} lg={5} />
```

#### Extra-large and max breakpoints

`lg`, `xlg`, and `max` all share the same 16-column grid, but the viewport keeps growing past `lg`. Set `xlg` and `max` independently when a layout needs a different span on very wide screens instead of stretching the `lg` value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Column sm={4} md={8} lg={8} xlg={6} max={4} />
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Row>
    <Column sm={1} md={4} lg={8}>sm: 1, md: 4, lg: 8</Column>
    <Column sm={1} md={2} lg={2}>sm: 1, md: 2, lg: 2</Column>
    <Column sm={1} md={1} lg={1}>sm: 1, md: 1, lg: 1</Column>
    <Column sm={1} md={1} lg={1}>sm: 1, md: 1, lg: 1</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

#### Offset

Create space between columns using the offset feature for more flexible layouts without empty columns.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Row>
    <Column sm={{ span: 1, offset: 3 }}>Offset 3</Column>
    <Column sm={{ span: 2, offset: 2 }}>Offset 2</Column>
    <Column sm={{ span: 3, offset: 1 }}>Offset 1</Column>
    <Column sm={{ span: 4, offset: 0 }}>Offset 0</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

#### Aspect ratio

Maintain consistent column heights using aspect ratio columns. This ensures content alignment across different column widths.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Row>
    <Column aspectRatio="2x1">2x1</Column>
    <Column aspectRatio="2x1">2x1</Column>
  </Row>
</Grid>
```

### Spacing

Control vertical rhythm and horizontal gutters at the grid, row, or column level.

#### Padding

Add vertical padding (top/bottom) with `padding`. Apply it at the grid, row, or column level to control spacing between rows of content. This is useful for creating vertical rhythm without manually adding margins.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div style="padding: var(--cds-spacing-05)">
    Adding padding to Grid applies it to columns in all rows:
  </div>

  <Grid padding>
    <Row>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>

  <div style="padding: var(--cds-spacing-05)">
    Adding padding to a Row only applies to its columns:
  </div>

  <Grid>
    <Row padding>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
    </Row>
    <Row>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>

  <div style="padding: var(--cds-spacing-05)">
    Adding padding to a specific column only applies it to the column:
  </div>

  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column padding>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
```

#### Gutter

Remove the horizontal gutter with `noGutter`, or remove just one side with `noGutterLeft` / `noGutterRight`. These props are available on `Grid`, `Row`, and `Column`, so you can drop the gutter globally or flush a single column against an edge or divider.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div style="padding: var(--cds-spacing-05)">
    Adding noGutter to Grid removes the gutter from every column:
  </div>

  <Grid noGutter>
    <Row>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>

  <div style="padding: var(--cds-spacing-05)">
    Adding noGutterLeft or noGutterRight to individual columns removes only that
    side's gutter--useful for flushing a column against a page edge or divider:
  </div>

  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column noGutterLeft>No left gutter</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column>Column</Column>
      <Column noGutterRight>No right gutter</Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
```

### Custom element

Set `as` to `true` on `Grid`, `Row`, or `Column` to render a semantic element instead of the default `<div>`. Props are destructured as `props` in the default slot and must be spread onto the custom element to keep the Carbon grid classes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Column, Grid, Row } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Grid as let:props>
  <main {...props}>
    <Row as let:props>
      <section {...props}>
        <Column as let:props>
          <article {...props}>Content</article>
        </Column>
      </section>
    </Row>
  </main>
</Grid>
```

### Breakpoints reference

Understanding [breakpoints](/components/Breakpoint) is critical for creating responsive layouts. Each breakpoint has specific pixel ranges and column counts:

| Breakpoint          | Viewport width   | Columns | Typical use               |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | ------- | ------------------------- |
| **Small (`sm`)**    | 0-671px          | 4       | Mobile phones             |
| **Medium (`md`)**   | 672-1055px       | 8       | Tablets, small laptops    |
| **Large (`lg`)**    | 1056-1311px      | 16      | Desktop monitors, laptops |
| **X-Large (`xlg`)** | 1312-1583px      | 16      | Large desktop monitors    |
| **Max (`max`)**     | 1584px and above | 16      | Extra-large displays      |

When designing responsive layouts, start with mobile (sm) and work your way up to ensure your content works well at all sizes.

---

## Heading

### Basic

A top-level heading inside a section renders as an h1 element, a semantic starting point for your document structure.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section>
  <Heading>Heading 1</Heading>
</Section>
```

### Standalone heading

A `Heading` used without a `Section` ancestor also defaults to h1. Wrap headings in `Section` when you need automatic level management as content nests.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Heading>Standalone Heading</Heading>
```

### Heading levels

`Heading` reads its semantic level (h1-h6) from the nearest `Section` context. Levels advance automatically as sections nest, and can be given a custom starting point.

#### Nested sections

As you nest sections, heading levels automatically increment to maintain proper hierarchy. Each nested section increases the heading level by one (h1 → h2 → h3, and so on). Heading levels cap at h6 to ensure valid HTML structure, even when nested deeper than six levels.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section>
  <Heading>Heading 1</Heading>
  <Section>
    <Heading>Heading 2</Heading>
    <Section>
      <Heading>Heading 3</Heading>
      <Section>
        <Heading>Heading 4</Heading>
        <Section>
          <Heading>Heading 5</Heading>
          <Section>
            <Heading>Heading 6</Heading>
            <Section>
              <Heading>Capped at Heading 6</Heading>
            </Section>
          </Section>
        </Section>
      </Section>
    </Section>
  </Section>
</Section>
```

#### Custom starting level

Set a custom starting heading level with `level` on the section. Child sections continue to increment from this level.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section level={5}>
  <Heading>Starts at Heading 5</Heading>
  <Section>
    <Heading>Heading 6</Heading>
  </Section>
</Section>
```

### Custom section element

The section renders a semantic section element by default. Set `tag` to render a different element (such as div, article, or aside) while keeping automatic heading level management.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section tag="div">
  <Heading>Heading 1</Heading>
</Section>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Heading` typedefs

```ts
type SectionLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
```

#### `Heading` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Section` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `SectionLevel` | Specify the heading level the section should start at.<br />When nested, child sections automatically increment from this level.<br />Levels are capped at 6 (h6).<br />@default 1 | `1` |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the HTML tag name to render instead of the default `section` element.<br />Useful when you need to use a different semantic element while maintaining<br />the heading level context functionality.<br />@default section | `"section"` |

#### `Section` typedefs

```ts
type SectionLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
```

#### `Section` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |


## IconIndicator

### Basic

Create an icon indicator with `kind` and `label`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
```

### Kinds

Set `kind` to match the status being communicated.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <IconIndicator kind="failed" label="Failed" />
  <IconIndicator kind="caution-major" label="Caution major" />
  <IconIndicator kind="caution-minor" label="Caution minor" />
  <IconIndicator kind="undefined" label="Undefined" />
  <IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
  <IconIndicator kind="normal" label="Normal" />
  <IconIndicator kind="in-progress" label="In progress" />
  <IconIndicator kind="incomplete" label="Incomplete" />
  <IconIndicator kind="not-started" label="Not started" />
  <IconIndicator kind="pending" label="Pending" />
  <IconIndicator kind="unknown" label="Unknown" />
  <IconIndicator kind="informative" label="Informative" />
</Stack>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control the icon and label size.

#### 16px (default)

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
```

#### 20px

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" size={20} />
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot for custom label content instead of `label`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Custom label</strong>
</IconIndicator>
```

---

### Component API

#### `IconIndicator` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` (Required) | `"failed" \| "caution-major" \| "caution-minor" \| "undefined" \| "succeeded" \| "normal" \| "in-progress" \| "incomplete" \| "not-started" \| "pending" \| "unknown" \| "informative"` | Specify the kind of the icon indicator. | _undefined_ |
| `label` (Required) | `string` | Specify the label displayed next to the icon. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `16 \| 20` | Specify the size of the icon indicator. | `16` |

#### `IconIndicator` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `IconIndicator` $$restProps

`IconIndicator` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ImageLoader

### Basic

Load an image with the default configuration. The component handles the loading process automatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Alt text

Set `alt` to provide alternative text for the image.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  alt="IBM logo"
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Aspect ratio

Maintain consistent image dimensions using aspect ratios. The component uses [AspectRatio](/components/AspectRatio) to constrain the image.

Supported aspect ratios include `"2x1"`, `"2x3"`, `"16x9"`, `"4x3"`, `"1x1"`, `"3x4"`, `"3x2"`, `"9x16"` and `"1x2"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  ratio="16x9"
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Fade in

Enable a smooth fade-in animation when the image loads successfully.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  on:click={() => {
    key++;
  }}>Reload image</Button
>
{#key key}<ImageLoader
    fadeIn
    ratio="16x9"
    src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
  />{/key}
```

### Loading and error states

ImageLoader tracks its own loading, loaded, and error state internally. Customize the UI shown at each stage, read the state directly, or listen for events.

#### Slots

Customize the loading and error states using named slots.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader, InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="loading">
    <InlineLoading />
  </svelte:fragment>
  <svelte:fragment slot="error">An error occurred.</svelte:fragment>
</ImageLoader>
```

#### Bindable state

Bind to `loading`, `loaded`, and `error` to read the image's state. All three props are readonly outside the component and are set automatically as the image loads.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import imageError from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/imageError.svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  bind:loading
  bind:loaded
  bind:error={imageError}
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
<p>loading: {loading} · loaded: {loaded} · error: {imageError}</p>
```

#### Events

Dispatches `load` when the image loads successfully, and `error` when it fails to load.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  on:load={() => console.log("loaded")}
  on:error={() => console.log("error")}
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Updating the image source

Change the image displayed by the same ImageLoader instance, either imperatively or by reacting to a changing `src` value.

#### Programmatic

Control image loading programmatically using component references.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const src =
    "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg";
  const srcError = `${src}1`;

  let imageLoader;
  let imageLoadError;
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  disabled={!imageLoader || imageLoadError}
  on:click={() => imageLoader.loadImage(srcError)}
>
  Simulate error
</Button>

<ImageLoader bind:this={imageLoader} bind:error={imageLoadError} fadeIn {src}>
  <svelte:fragment slot="error">
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={() => imageLoader.loadImage(src)}>
      Error. Try again
    </Button>
  </svelte:fragment>
</ImageLoader>
```

#### Dynamic

Update the image source dynamically using the same image loader instance for smooth transitions between images.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const images = [
    "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1b/Svelte_Logo.svg",
    "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Carbon-design-system-logo.png",
  ];

  let index = 0;

  $: src = images[index];
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  on:click={() => {
    index = index === 0 ? 1 : 0;
  }}
>
  Toggle image
</Button>

<div style:margin-top="1rem" style:width="100%" style:max-width="120px">
  <ImageLoader ratio="1x1" fadeIn {src} alt={src} />
</div>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ImageLoader` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` when `loaded` is `true` and `error` is false. | `false` |
| `loaded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` when the image is loaded. | `false` |
| `error` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` if an error occurs when loading the image. | `false` |
| `src` | `string` | Specify the image source. | `""` |
| `alt` | `string` | Specify the image alt text. | `""` |
| `ratio` | `"2x1" \| "16x9" \| "4x3" \| "1x1" \| "3x4" \| "3x2" \| "9x16" \| "1x2"` | Specify the aspect ratio for the image wrapper. | _undefined_ |
| `fadeIn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to fade in the image on load.<br />The duration uses the `fast-02` value following Carbon guidelines on motion. | `false` |
| `loadImage` | `(url?: string) => void` | Method invoked to load the image provided a `src` value.<br />If no URL is provided, uses the component's `src` prop. | _undefined_ |

#### `ImageLoader` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `error`   | `Record<string, never>` |
| `loading` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ImageLoader` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:error` | `null` |
| `on:load`  | `null` |

#### `ImageLoader` $$restProps

`ImageLoader` spreads `$$restProps` to the `img` element.


## InlineLoading

### Basic

Display a basic loading indicator with the default configuration.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading />
```

### With description

Add a descriptive text to provide context about the loading operation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading description="Loading metrics..." />
```

### Statuses

The component supports different status states to indicate progress:

| Status       | Description                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| **active**   | Shows an animated loading indicator |
| **inactive** | Displays a static state             |
| **finished** | Shows a success state               |
| **error**    | Displays an error state             |

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading status="active" description="Submitting..." />
<InlineLoading status="inactive" description="Cancelling..." />
<InlineLoading status="finished" description="Success" />
<InlineLoading status="error" description="An error occurred" />
```

#### Icon description

Set `iconDescription` to override the accessible label announced for the status icon. For the `"finished"` and `"error"` states, it defaults to the `status` value if not set.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading
  status="error"
  iconDescription="Upload failed"
  description="An error occurred"
/>
```

### Events

Listen for `on:success`, dispatched `successDelay` milliseconds (default `1500`) after `status` is set to `"finished"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading
  status="finished"
  description="Success"
  successDelay={1000}
  on:success={() => console.log("success")}
/>
```

### UX example

See how to integrate the loading indicator in a real-world scenario.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet, InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { onMount } from "svelte";

  const descriptionMap = {
    active: "Submitting...",
    finished: "Success",
    inactive: "Cancelling...",
  };

  const stateMap = {
    active: "finished",
    inactive: "dormant",
    finished: "dormant",
  };

  let timeout = undefined;
  let state = "dormant"; // "dormant" | "active" | "finished" | "inactive"

  function reset(incomingState) {
    if (typeof timeout === "number") {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
    }

    if (incomingState) {
      timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        state = incomingState;
      }, 2000);
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    return () => {
      reset();
    };
  });

  $: reset(stateMap[state]);
</script>

<ButtonSet>
  <Button
    kind="ghost"
    disabled={state === "dormant" || state === "finished"}
    on:click={() => (state = "inactive")}
  >
    Cancel
  </Button>
  {#if state !== "dormant"}
    <InlineLoading status={state} description={descriptionMap[state]} />
  {:else}
    <Button on:click={() => (state = "active")}>Submit</Button>
  {/if}
</ButtonSet>
```

---

### Component API

#### `InlineLoading` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"active" \| "inactive" \| "finished" \| "error"` | Set the loading status. | `"active"` |
| `description` | `string` | Set the loading description. | _undefined_ |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify a description for the loading icon.<br />Defaults to the `status` prop for the "error" and "finished" states. | _undefined_ |
| `successDelay` | `number` | Specify the timeout delay (ms) before the `success` event fires after `status` is set to "finished" | `1500` |

#### `InlineLoading` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `InlineLoading` dispatched events

| Event        | Detail |
| ------------ | ------ |
| `on:success` | `null` |

#### `InlineLoading` $$restProps

`InlineLoading` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## InlineNotification

### Basic

Display a basic error notification with title and subtitle by default. See [detailed usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/notification/usage) and the related [ToastNotification](ToastNotification).

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="Error:"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
/>
```

### Reusable

Control notification visibility by binding to `open` to show, hide, and reuse the same component with different messages. Open defaults to true.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    InlineNotification,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let kind = "error";
  let title = "Error:";
  let subtitle = "An internal server error occurred.";

  function showError() {
    kind = "error";
    title = "Error:";
    subtitle = "An internal server error occurred.";
    open = true;
  }

  function showSuccess() {
    kind = "success";
    title = "Success:";
    subtitle = "Your settings have been saved.";
    open = true;
  }

  function showWarning() {
    kind = "warning";
    title = "Warning:";
    subtitle = "Please review your changes before continuing.";
    open = true;
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button on:click={showSuccess}>Show success</Button>
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={showWarning}>Show warning</Button>
    <Button kind="danger-ghost" on:click={showError}>Show error</Button>
  </ButtonSet>

  <InlineNotification bind:open {kind} {title} {subtitle} />
</Stack>
```

### Autoclose

Automatically close the notification after a specified duration (in milliseconds) with `timeout`. Set `pauseOnHover` to pause the timeout while the pointer is over the notification so users can finish reading (opt-in).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { fade } from "svelte/transition";

  let timeout = undefined;
  $: showNotification = timeout !== undefined;
</script>

<Button
  disabled={showNotification}
  on:click={() => {
    timeout = 3_000; // 3 seconds
  }}
>
  Show notification
</Button>

{#if showNotification}
  <div transition:fade>
    <InlineNotification
      {timeout}
      pauseOnHover
      kind="success"
      title="Success:"
      subtitle="This notification will autoclose in {timeout.toLocaleString()} ms. Hover to pause the countdown."
      on:close={(e) => {
        timeout = undefined;
        console.log(e.detail.timeout); // true if closed via timeout
      }}
    />
  </div>
{/if}
```

### Title and subtitle

Both the title and subtitle are optional and can be customized with slots.

#### Optional

Title and subtitle only render when provided.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification subtitle="An internal server error occurred." />
<InlineNotification title="An error occurred." />
```

#### Custom (slots)

Customize the notification content using slots for more flexibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification>
  <span slot="titleChildren">Error: </span>
  <strong slot="subtitleChildren">An internal server error occurred.</strong>
</InlineNotification>
```

### Actions

Add interactive elements to notifications using the actions slot.

#### Action button

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    InlineNotification,
    NotificationActionButton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="warning"
  title="Scheduled maintenance:"
  subtitle="Maintenance will last 2-4 hours."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
    <NotificationActionButton>Learn more</NotificationActionButton>
  </svelte:fragment>
</InlineNotification>
```

#### Link

The notification action button accepts an href prop to render as a link instead of a button.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    InlineNotification,
    NotificationActionButton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="info"
  title="New features available:"
  subtitle="Check out what's new in this release."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
    <NotificationActionButton
      href="https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-components-svelte/releases"
      target="_blank">View release notes</NotificationActionButton
    >
  </svelte:fragment>
</InlineNotification>
```

### Close button

Hide the close button or customize its behavior and label.

#### Hidden

Create a persistent notification by hiding the close button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  hideCloseButton
  kind="warning"
  title="Scheduled maintenance:"
  subtitle="Maintenance will last 2-4 hours."
/>
```

#### Translated label

Translate the close button label via `closeButtonDescription`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="错误"
  subtitle="发生内部服务器错误"
  closeButtonDescription="关闭通知"
/>
```

#### Prevent default

The component is controlled, so you can prevent the default close behavior with `e.preventDefault()`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="Error"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
  on:close={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // custom close logic (e.g., transitions)
  }}
/>

## ARIA role Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container to control
how screen readers announce it. Defaults to `"alert"` for interruptive
announcements. Use `"status"` for polite live-region updates, or `"log"` for a
running log of messages.

<InlineNotification
  role="status"
  kind="success"
  title="Success:"
  subtitle="Your settings have been saved."
/>

contrast
```

### Component API

#### `InlineNotification` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the notification, `false` to hide it. | `true` |
| `kind` | `"error" \| "info" \| "info-square" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "warning-alt"` | Specify the kind of notification. | `"error"` |
| `lowContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant | `false` |
| `timeout` | `number` | Set the timeout duration (ms) to hide the notification after opening it | `0` |
| `pauseOnHover` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to pause the auto-dismiss timeout while the pointer is over the notification. | `false` |
| `role` | `"alert" \| "log" \| "status"` | Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container. | `"alert"` |
| `title` | `string` | Specify the title text | `""` |
| `subtitle` | `string` | Specify the subtitle text | `""` |
| `hideCloseButton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the close button | `false` |
| `closeButtonDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the close button | `"Close notification"` |

#### `InlineNotification` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `actions`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `subtitleChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `titleChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `InlineNotification` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `InlineNotification` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail                              |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  timeout: boolean;<br />}` |

#### `InlineNotification` $$restProps

`InlineNotification` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `NotificationActionButton` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `NotificationActionButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `NotificationActionButton` $$restProps

`NotificationActionButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `Button` component.


## Link

### Basic

Create a basic link with the default styling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Link href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">Carbon Design System</Link>
```

### Inline

Create links that flow naturally with surrounding text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  Visit the
  <Link inline href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">
    Carbon Design System
  </Link>.
</div>
```

### Muted

Set `muted` to `true` so the link inherits the surrounding text color instead of the link color. Pair it with `inline` for links that sit within body text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text>
  Read the
  <Link inline muted href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">
    Carbon Design System
  </Link>
  documentation for usage guidelines and component examples.
</Text>
```

### External links

Use these patterns when linking to resources outside your app.

#### Opens in new tab

For external links that open in a new tab, the component automatically adds security attributes (rel="noopener noreferrer"). Override rel if needed.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Link href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/" target="_blank">
  Carbon Design System
</Link>
```

#### Outbound link

Use `OutboundLink` as a convenient alternative for external links. Because it opens in a new tab (`target="_blank"`), it adds visually hidden text ("(opens in a new tab)") so screen readers announce the behavior.

```svelte
<script>
  import { OutboundLink } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<OutboundLink href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">
  Carbon Design System
</OutboundLink>
```

#### Custom assistive text

External links open in a new tab and append assistive text automatically for screen readers. Override `assistiveText` if needed, or set it to an empty string to opt out.

```svelte
<script>
  import { OutboundLink } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<OutboundLink
  href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/"
  assistiveText="(opens in a new window)"
>
  Carbon Design System
</OutboundLink>
```

### Download link

Use `LinkDownload` to trigger a client-side file download instead of navigating to a URL. Set `data` to the content to download, a string or `Blob`, and `filename` for the downloaded file name.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LinkDownload } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LinkDownload
  data="id,name{'\n'}1,Alpha{'\n'}2,Bravo"
  filename="items.csv"
  type="text/csv;charset=utf-8"
>
  Download CSV
</LinkDownload>
```

#### Dynamic content

`data` is read at the moment the link is clicked, so downloaded content reflects filtering, sorting, or other state changes made before the click.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LinkDownload, Search, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const loadBalancers = [
    { id: "1", name: "lb-east", region: "us-east-1" },
    { id: "2", name: "lb-west", region: "us-west-2" },
    { id: "3", name: "lb-central", region: "us-central-1" },
  ];

  let value = "";

  $: filteredRows = loadBalancers.filter((row) =>
    row.name.toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase()),
  );

  $: csv = [
    "id,name,region",
    ...filteredRows.map((row) => `${row.id},${row.name},${row.region}`),
  ].join("\n");
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Search
    bind:value
    labelText="Filter load balancers"
    placeholder="Filter by name..."
  />
  <ul>
    {#each filteredRows as row (row.id)}
      <li>{row.name} ({row.region})</li>
    {/each}
  </ul>
  <LinkDownload
    data={csv}
    filename="load-balancers.csv"
    type="text/csv;charset=utf-8"
  >
    Download CSV
  </LinkDownload>
</Stack>
```

#### Events

Listen for `download`, dispatched after the file downloads successfully, and `download:error`, dispatched if the download throws, with the error at `event.detail.error`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LinkDownload } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LinkDownload
  data="id,name{'\n'}1,Alpha{'\n'}2,Bravo"
  filename="items.csv"
  type="text/csv;charset=utf-8"
  on:download={() => console.log("downloaded")}
  on:download:error={(e) => console.log(e.detail.error)}
>
  Download CSV
</LinkDownload>
```

#### Custom download behavior

Override the default download behavior by passing a function to `download`. It receives `(data, filename, type)` and can return a promise; use it to upload the payload, show a confirmation step, or otherwise replace the built-in Blob download.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LinkDownload } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LinkDownload
  data="id,name{'\n'}1,Alpha{'\n'}2,Bravo"
  filename="items.csv"
  download={(data, filename, type) => console.log(data, filename, type)}
>
  Download CSV
</LinkDownload>
```

### States

Reflect interaction and navigation history.

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to disable the link. Native `<a>` elements have no `disabled` attribute, so the link instead renders with `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`, and drops its `href`, remaining focusable and readable by assistive technology while looking and behaving like plain text. Clicks are also blocked outright--`event.preventDefault()` and `event.stopPropagation()` run before any forwarded `on:click` listener, so neither the link nor an ancestor element receives the click.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Link disabled href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">Disabled link</Link>
```

#### Disabled with icon

The icon still renders when the link is disabled.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<Link disabled href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/" icon={Carbon}>
  Disabled link
</Link>
```

#### Visited

Show visited state styling with `visited`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Link visited href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">Visited link</Link>
```

## LocalStorage

### Basic

See how the component maintains state across page reloads. Toggle the switch and refresh the page to see the persisted state. Unlike [SessionStorage](/components/SessionStorage), data persists indefinitely and is shared across all tabs of the same origin.

The component listens for the [storage event](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/storage_event), so changes made in one browser tab are automatically synchronized to other tabs with the same key. Cross-tab updates dispatch `on:update` with a payload shaped like `{ prevValue, value }`. When another tab removes the key, the bound value resets to undefined so the next local write does not re-persist stale data.

The example below logs both `on:save` and `on:update` as they fire; see [Events](#events) for what each one means.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LocalStorage, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = false;
  let events = [];

  $: document.documentElement.setAttribute("theme", toggled ? "g100" : "white");
</script>

<LocalStorage
  key="dark-mode"
  bind:value={toggled}
  on:save={() => {
    events = [...events, { event: "on:save" }];
  }}
  on:update={({ detail }) => {
    events = [...events, { event: "on:update", detail }];
  }}
/>

<Toggle size="sm" labelText="Dark mode" bind:toggled />

<br />

<pre>{JSON.stringify(events, null, 2)}</pre>
```

### Persisting objects and arrays

The bound value can be any JSON-serializable data; objects and arrays are serialized with JSON.stringify. The component compares the serialized form to decide when to write, which has two consequences:

- Reassigning to a new object or array with **identical contents** does not trigger a redundant write.
- **In-place mutations** (for example, changing a nested theme property) persist only when you signal the change to Svelte. Reassign the value (`value = { ...value, theme: "light" }`) or use the self-assignment idiom (`value = value`); a bare mutation alone will not re-render and therefore will not persist.

In this example, the text inputs bind directly to nested properties and the button mutates the object in place. Edit a field and refresh the page to confirm the change is persisted.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    LocalStorage,
    Stack,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  // A nested object value. Editing a nested field -- either through a two-way
  // binding or an explicit in-place mutation signalled with `value = value` --
  // is persisted because the component compares the serialized form.
  let settings = { profile: { name: "Ada", role: "Engineer" }, visits: 0 };
  let events = [];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <LocalStorage
    key="local-storage-object-example"
    bind:value={settings}
    on:update={({ detail }) => {
      events = [...events, { event: "on:update", detail }];
    }}
  />

  <div>
    Edit the nested fields below, then refresh the page to confirm the changes
    survive. The two-way bindings mutate <code>settings</code> in place; the component
    still persists them.
  </div>

  <TextInput
    labelText="Name (binds to settings.profile.name)"
    bind:value={settings.profile.name}
  />

  <TextInput
    labelText="Role (binds to settings.profile.role)"
    bind:value={settings.profile.role}
  />

  <Button
    size="small"
    on:click={() => {
      settings.visits += 1; // in-place mutation
      settings = settings; // signal the change to Svelte
    }}
  >
    Increment visits ({settings.visits})
  </Button>

  <div>
    <strong>Current value:</strong>
    <pre>{JSON.stringify(settings, null, 2)}</pre>
  </div>

  <div>
    <strong>Updates (note prevValue is a true snapshot):</strong>
    <pre>{JSON.stringify(events, null, 2)}</pre>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Reactive key

The storage key is also reactive -- set `key` to switch between contexts, useful for per-user settings.

In this example, each user has their own theme preference stored under a separate key. When you switch users, the component automatically loads that user's saved preference.

Switching keys only hydrates the bound value from storage; it does not dispatch `on:update`. The event log below should stay empty when you change users and only record entries when you change the theme.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    LocalStorage,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedUser = "user-1";
  let theme = "white";
  let events = [];

  $: storageKey = `local-storage-reactive-example-${selectedUser}`;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    Try selecting different users and changing their theme preferences. Each
    user's preference is stored separately and persists across page reloads.
  </div>
  <LocalStorage
    key={storageKey}
    bind:value={theme}
    on:update={({ detail }) => {
      events = [...events, { event: "on:update", detail }];
    }}
  />
  <RadioButtonGroup legendText="Select user" bind:selected={selectedUser}>
    <RadioButton labelText="User 1" value="user-1" />
    <RadioButton labelText="User 2" value="user-2" />
    <RadioButton labelText="User 3" value="user-3" />
  </RadioButtonGroup>
  <RadioButtonGroup legendText="Theme preference" bind:selected={theme}>
    <RadioButton labelText="White" value="white" />
    <RadioButton labelText="Gray 10" value="g10" />
    <RadioButton labelText="Gray 80" value="g80" />
    <RadioButton labelText="Gray 90" value="g90" />
    <RadioButton labelText="Gray 100" value="g100" />
  </RadioButtonGroup>
  <Stack gap={2}>
    <div>
      <strong>Current key:</strong>
      {storageKey}
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Current theme:</strong>
      {theme}
    </div>
  </Stack>
  <strong> Updates: </strong>
  <pre>{JSON.stringify(events, null, 2)}</pre>
</Stack>
```

### Disabling cross-tab sync

With sync enabled by default, another tab writing the same key updates the bound value and fires `on:update`. Set `sync="off"` to ignore those writes. The component still loads storage on mount and saves your own changes.

Use sync off when each tab should keep separate state: drafts, forms in progress, or a second login tab that should not clobber the first. You can also turn sync off if the app resolves conflicts itself. Sync is reactive, so you can change it at runtime.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LocalStorage } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LocalStorage key="draft" bind:value sync="off" />
```

### Clear item, clear all

The component provides methods to manage stored data:

| Method      | Description                       |
| ----------- | --------------------------------- |
| `clearItem` | Remove a specific key-value pair. |
| `clearAll`  | Remove all stored data.           |

Use `bind:this` to access these methods. They only clear browser storage in the current tab; they do not reset the bound value. Other tabs with the same key will reset their bound value when they receive the storage event. To clear both storage and the bound value in the current tab, reset the value yourself after calling clearItem or clearAll -- if you don't, the next mutation to `value` persists as normal and silently rewrites the key you just cleared, since clearing storage doesn't change the component's own record of what `value` currently is.

In this example, try toggling the switch, refreshing the page, then clearing the storage.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, LocalStorage, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let storage;
  let toggled = false;

  $: document.documentElement.setAttribute("theme", toggled ? "g100" : "white");
</script>

<LocalStorage bind:this={storage} bind:value={toggled} />

<Toggle size="sm" labelText="Dark mode" bind:toggled />

<br />
<br />

<Button size="small" on:click={storage.clearAll}>Clear storage</Button>
```

### Events

The component dispatches three events: `save`, `update`, and `error`.

#### Update

Fires whenever the persisted value changes -- after your own `bind:value` write, or when another tab or window writes the same key while `sync` is `"on"` (the default). The payload is `{ prevValue, value }`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LocalStorage } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LocalStorage
  key="dark-mode"
  bind:value
  on:update={({ detail }) => console.log(detail)} // { prevValue, value }
/>
```

#### Save

Fires once, when the component mounts, if the key does not already exist in storage -- this is the component's own first write to initialize that key. Switching to a different key afterward (see [Reactive key](#reactive-key)) does not dispatch `save`, even if the new key has no stored value yet.

#### Error

Fires when a write to storage fails, for example when the storage quota is exceeded or storage access is denied (such as private browsing modes that disable storage). The payload is `{ error }`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LocalStorage } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<LocalStorage
  key="my-key"
  bind:value
  on:error={({ detail }) => console.error(detail.error)}
/>
```

---

### Component API

#### `LocalStorage` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `T` | Provide a value to persist. | `""` |
| `key` | `string` | Specify the local storage key. | `"local-storage-key"` |
| `sync` | `"on" \| "off"` | `"off"` ignores storage events from other tabs or windows on the same<br />origin. `"on"` (default) keeps the previous behavior. | `"on"` |
| `clearItem` | `() => void` | Remove the persisted key value from the browser's local storage.<br />Note: this only clears storage; the bound `value` is left untouched.<br />If `value` mutates afterwards, it will be re-persisted. Reset `value`<br />yourself if you want it cleared as well. | _undefined_ |
| `clearAll` | `() => void` | Clear all key values from the browser's local storage.<br />Note: this only clears storage; the bound `value` is left untouched.<br />If `value` mutates afterwards, it will be re-persisted. Reset `value`<br />yourself if you want it cleared as well. | _undefined_ |

#### `LocalStorage` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:error` | `{ error: unknown }` | Fires when a write to localStorage fails (e.g. quota exceeded or access denied). |
| `on:save` | `null` |  |
| `on:update` | `{<br />  prevValue: T;<br />  value: T;<br />}` | Fires when the stored value changes, either from a bound value update or when localStorage is modified from another tab or window. Set `sync` to `"off"` to ignore updates from other tabs. |


## Menu

### Basic

Menu positions its content relative to an `anchor` element and does not render a trigger of its own. Bind a reference to the element that opens the menu, then control `open` from that element's event handler. Use `MenuItem` for each action; set `disabled` to make an item non-interactive.

The root element has `role="menu"`. Set `labelText` or `aria-label` on Menu so assistive technologies get a meaningful name, since there is no visible text the menu is otherwise associated with.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Menu, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let anchor;
  let open = false;
</script>

<Button bind:ref={anchor} on:click={() => (open = !open)}>Actions</Button>

<Menu {anchor} bind:open labelText="Actions menu">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Cut")}>Cut</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Copy")}>Copy</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Paste")}>Paste</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem disabled>Delete</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

### Size

Set `size` to control each item's row height. The default is `"sm"`.

#### Extra small

`"xs"` is a compact row height for dense layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Menu, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let anchor;
  let open = false;
</script>

<Button bind:ref={anchor} on:click={() => (open = !open)}>Actions</Button>

<Menu {anchor} size="xs" bind:open labelText="Actions menu">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Cut")}>Cut</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Copy")}>Copy</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Paste")}>Paste</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

```svelte
<Button bind:ref={anchor} on:click={() => (open = !open)}>Actions</Button>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Menu, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let anchor;

<Button bind:ref={anchor} on:click={() => (open = !open)}>Actions</Button>
```
