### Component API

#### `Pagination` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the current page index. | `1` |
| `pageSize` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the number of items to display in a page. | `10` |
| `totalItems` | `number` | Specify the total number of items | `0` |
| `pageWindow` | `number` | If `totalItems` is a large number, it can affect the<br />rendering performance of this component since its value<br />is used to calculate the number of pages in the native<br />select dropdown. This value creates a small window of<br />pages rendered around the current page. By default,<br />a maximum of 1000 page `<option>` elements are rendered. | `1000` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the pagination | `false` |
| `forwardText` | `string` | Specify the forward button text | `"Next page"` |
| `forwardTextTooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Specify the tooltip position for the forward button. | `"top"` |
| `backwardText` | `string` | Specify the backward button text | `"Previous page"` |
| `backwardTextTooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Specify the tooltip position for the backward button. | `"top"` |
| `itemsPerPageText` | `string` | Specify the items per page text | `"Items per page:"` |
| `itemText` | `(min: number, max: number) => string` | Override the item text. | `(min, max) => `${min.toLocaleString()}-${max.toLocaleString()} item${max === 1 ? "" : "s"}`` |
| `itemRangeText` | `(min: number, max: number, total: number) => string` | Override the item range text. | `(min, max, total) => `${min.toLocaleString()}-${max.toLocaleString()} of ${total.toLocaleString()} item${max === 1 ? "" : "s"}`` |
| `pageInputDisabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the page input | `false` |
| `pageSizeInputDisabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the page size input | `false` |
| `simple` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for a compact prev/next control with page status text.<br />Hides the page size and page selects. Suited to toolbars and cards. | `false` |
| `pageSizes` | `ReadonlyArray<number>` | Specify the available page sizes. | `[10]` |
| `dynamicPageSizes` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to dynamically filter page sizes based on total items.<br />Page sizes larger than needed to display all items on a single page are hidden. | `false` |
| `pagesUnknown` | `boolean` | Set to `true` if the number of pages is unknown | `false` |
| `forwardButtonDisabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | Override the disabled state of the forward (next page) button.<br />Intended for use with `pagesUnknown` (controlled), where the consumer<br />knows when there is no more data to load. | _undefined_ |
| `backButtonDisabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | Override the disabled state of the backward (previous page) button.<br />Intended for use with `pagesUnknown` (controlled), where the consumer<br />manages page bounds. | _undefined_ |
| `pageText` | `(page: number) => string` | Override the page text. | `(page) => `page ${page.toLocaleString()}`` |
| `pageRangeText` | `(current: number, total: number) => string` | Override the page range text. | `(_current, total) => `of ${total.toLocaleString()} page${total === 1 ? "" : "s"}`` |
| `pageSelectLabelText` | `(total: number) => string` | Override the accessible label for the page number select. | `(total) => `Page number, of ${total} pages`` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element | `uniqueId()` |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Specify the size of the pagination. | `"md"` |

#### `Pagination` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `pageSelect` | `{<br />  currentPage: number;<br />  totalPages: number;<br />  currentPageSize: number;<br />  selectLabelText: string;<br />}` |

#### `Pagination` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:change` | `{<br />  page?: number;<br />  pageSize?: number;<br />}` | Dispatched when the user changes the page or page size through any interaction. |
| `on:click:button--next` | `{<br />  page: number;<br />}` |  |
| `on:click:button--previous` | `{<br />  page: number;<br />}` |  |
| `on:update` | `{<br />  pageSize: number;<br />  page: number;<br />}` |  |

#### `Pagination` $$restProps

`Pagination` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Specify the size of the pagination. | `"md"` |

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

## PaginationNav

### Basic

Create a basic pagination navigation with default settings.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav />
```

### Reactive

Bind to `page` for the current page number.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, PaginationNav, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let page = 2;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <PaginationNav bind:page />
  <Stack gap={4} orientation="horizontal" align="center">
    <Button
      kind="tertiary"
      size="small"
      on:click={() => (page = 1)}
      disabled={page === 0}
    >
      Set page to 1
    </Button>
    <div>
      <strong>Current page:</strong>
      {page}
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Page count

#### Total pages

Specify the total number of pages with `total`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav total={3} />
```

#### Visible pages

Control the number of visible page numbers with `shown`. Pages that don't fit collapse into an overflow menu.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav total={100} shown={5} />
```

### Navigation buttons

The forward and backward navigation buttons can be customized independently of the page numbers.

#### Loop

Enable circular navigation between pages with `loop`. When enabled, clicking "Next" from the last page wraps to the first page, and clicking "Previous" from the first page wraps to the last page.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav total={3} loop />
```

#### Custom text

Customize navigation button text with `forwardText` and `backwardText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav forwardText="Next" backwardText="Previous" />
```

#### Tooltip position

Set tooltip position relative to the navigation buttons with `tooltipPosition`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav tooltipPosition="outside" total={3} loop />
```

### Events

#### Change

Use `on:change` to listen for every user interaction--clicking a page number, an overflow menu item, or the previous/next buttons. The event detail includes the resulting page.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav
  total={5}
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // { page: number }
/>
```

#### Button clicks

Use `on:click:button--previous` and `on:click:button--next` to listen specifically for previous and next button clicks, separate from the page numbers and overflow menu. Both dispatch the resulting page number.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaginationNav } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PaginationNav
  total={5}
  on:click:button--previous={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // { page: number }
  on:click:button--next={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // { page: number }
/>
```

---

### Component API

#### `PaginationNav` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the current page index. | `1` |
| `total` | `number` | Specify the total number of pages | `10` |
| `shown` | `number` | Specify the total number of pages to show | `10` |
| `loop` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to loop the navigation | `false` |
| `forwardText` | `string` | Specify the forward button text | `"Next page"` |
| `backwardText` | `string` | Specify the backward button text | `"Previous page"` |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| "outside" \| "inside"` | Set the position of the tooltip relative to the pagination buttons. | `"bottom"` |

#### `PaginationNav` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:change` | `{<br />  page: number;<br />}` | Fires after every user interaction |
| `on:click:button--next` | `{<br />  page: number;<br />}` |  |
| `on:click:button--previous` | `{<br />  page: number;<br />}` |  |

#### `PaginationNav` $$restProps

`PaginationNav` spreads `$$restProps` to the `nav` element.


## PasswordInput

### Basic

Create a basic password input with a label and placeholder.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

### Visibility toggle

Control the show/hide password toggle button and its tooltip.

#### Value shown as text

Set `type` to `"text"` to show the password in plain text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  labelText="Password"
  type="text"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
  value="correct horse battery staple"
/>
```

#### Custom tooltip alignment

Customize visibility toggle placement with `tooltipAlignment` and `tooltipPosition`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  tooltipAlignment="start"
  tooltipPosition="left"
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Toggle labels

Customize the toggle button's tooltip and ARIA label text with `showPasswordLabel` and `hidePasswordLabel`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
  showPasswordLabel="Reveal password"
  hidePasswordLabel="Conceal password"
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput hideLabel labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput labelText="" placeholder="Enter password...">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Password</strong>
</PasswordInput>
```

### Helper text

Add helper text to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  helperText="Your password should be hard to guess"
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

### Light

Enable the light variant for use on dark backgrounds.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput light labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to embed the label inside the field. Fluid password inputs work standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), which applies the variant automatically. The fluid variant cannot be combined with the inline variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput fluid labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput fluid labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password...">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Password
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Your password should be hard to guess."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</PasswordInput>
```

#### Invalid

Fluid password inputs display the error message inside the field boundary. Long messages wrap to multiple lines.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  fluid
  invalid
  invalidText="Incorrect user name or password. Please verify your credentials and try again, or use the reset password link if you have forgotten your password."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  fluid
  warn
  warnText="Password has been reset."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Disabled

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the input is disabled.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  fluid
  disabled
  invalid
  invalidText="Incorrect user name or password."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Read-only

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the input is read-only.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  fluid
  readonly
  warn
  warnText="Password has been reset."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
  value="mySecretPassword123"
/>
```

### Inline

Display the input with an inline label layout.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput inline labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom inline label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput inline labelText="" placeholder="Enter password...">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Password</strong>
</PasswordInput>
```

### Sizes

The default input height is medium. Set `size` to choose another variant.

#### Extra-large

Use the extra-large size variant for increased visibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput size="xl" labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

#### Small

Use the small size variant for compact layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput size="sm" labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

#### Extra-small

Use the extra-small size variant for the most compact layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput size="xs" labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

### States

Reflect validation and interaction states.

#### Invalid

Display an error message when the input is invalid.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  invalid
  invalidText="Incorrect user name or password."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Warning

Show a warning message for non-critical issues.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  warn
  warnText="Password has been reset."
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
/>
```

#### Disabled

Disable the input to prevent user interaction.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput disabled labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
```

#### Read-only

Set the input to read-only to display a value that cannot be modified. The visibility toggle still works to show or hide the password.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInput
  readonly
  labelText="Password"
  placeholder="Enter password..."
  value="mySecretPassword123"
/>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state with the default skeleton variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInputSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInputSkeleton />
```

#### Without label

Show a loading state without a label by setting `hideLabel` to `true`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PasswordInputSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PasswordInputSkeleton hideLabel />
```

### Inside a modal

When used inside a Modal, the visibility toggle tooltip is automatically portalled to prevent clipping. Set `portalTooltip` to override this behavior.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, PasswordInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Modal
  bind:open
  modalHeading="Sign in"
  primaryButtonText="Submit"
  secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
  on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
>
  <PasswordInput labelText="Password" placeholder="Enter password..." />
</Modal>
```

## PinCodeInput

### Basic

By default, four numeric segments are rendered. Typing a digit advances focus to the next segment; <kbd>Backspace</kbd> moves to the previous segment, <kbd>Delete</kbd> clears the focused segment, and <kbd>←</kbd> / <kbd>→</kbd> move between segments.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Helper text

Add helper text below the input to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput
  labelText="Verification code"
  helperText="Enter the 4-digit code sent to your device"
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput hideLabel labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput labelText="Verification code">
  <span slot="labelChildren">
    Verification code (<Link href="/">resend</Link>)
  </span>
</PinCodeInput>
```

### Input rules

Control how many segments render and which characters are accepted.

#### Custom length

Use `count` to set the number of segments. For example, six is common for SMS, email, and authenticator OTP flows.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput count={6} labelText="Verification code" />
```

#### Alphanumeric

The default input mode is `"numeric"`. Set `type` to `"alphanumeric"` to allow letters and digits.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput type="alphanumeric" labelText="Invite code" />
```

#### Custom pattern

Use `pattern` to override the per-character test used for typing and paste. Pass a `RegExp` or a string compiled with `new RegExp(...)`. The pattern is matched against each individual character, not the full assembled value. When `pattern` is unset, `type` selects the numeric or alphanumeric preset.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput
  count={6}
  pattern={/^[0-9a-fA-F]$/}
  type="alphanumeric"
  uppercase
  labelText="Serial number"
  helperText="Enter the 6-character hex serial"
/>
```

#### Uppercase display

Set `uppercase` to `true` to display characters in uppercase. The bound value and code retain the original casing.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput type="alphanumeric" uppercase labelText="Invite code" />
```

### Masked

Set `mask` to `true` to obscure the entered characters. Each segment is masked while it is not focused and reveals its character when focused.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput mask labelText="Security code" />
```

### Placeholder

Non-fluid pin code inputs do not show a placeholder by default. Set `placeholder` to hint at empty segments and indicate expected length.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput placeholder="0" labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Sizes

The `size` prop sets the segment height. The default is `md`.

#### Extra-small

Set `size` to `"xs"` to render extra-small segments.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput size="xs" labelText="Verification code" />
```

#### Small

Set `size` to `"sm"` to render small segments.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput size="sm" labelText="Verification code" />
```

#### Extra-large

Set `size` to `"xl"` to render extra-large segments.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput size="xl" labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Light

Use the light variant for light-themed backgrounds by setting `light` to `true`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput light labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Select on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to `true` to select a segment's value when it receives focus. Without this prop, browsers typically select the value only when the segment receives keyboard focus (for example, via <kbd>Tab</kbd>), not on click.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput selectTextOnFocus labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Events

Respond to edits, completion, clearing, and paste or autofill.

#### Edits, completion, and clearing

The component emits the following events:

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `on:change` | Any edit (type, paste, delete). |
| `on:complete` | All segments become filled. This does not fire on mount with a prefilled value, but fires after user interaction fills every segment. |
| `on:clear` | All segments are emptied. |

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput
  labelText="Verification code"
  on:complete={(e) => console.log("complete", e.detail)}
  on:change={(e) => console.log("change", e.detail)}
  on:clear={() => console.log("clear")}
/>
```

#### Paste and autofill

Paste a full code into any segment to fill all segments at once. A partial paste fills from the focused segment forward. Non-matching characters are ignored. The `on:paste` event fires with the clipboard value (whitespace stripped) before segments are updated.

OS and password-manager autofill that inserts the whole code into one segment is distributed the same way. The first segment also sets `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, which lets browsers and mobile OSes offer a one-time-code autofill suggestion (for example, from an incoming SMS) for it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput
  labelText="Verification code"
  on:paste={(e) => console.log("paste", e.detail)}
/>
```

### Form name

Set `name` so the assembled code participates in native form submission (for example SvelteKit form actions and `FormData`). A hidden input mirrors `value`. When `name` is set, `required` is applied to the hidden input instead of each segment.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Form, PinCodeInput, Button } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Form method="POST" action="?/verify">
  <PinCodeInput name="code" required count={6} labelText="Verification code" />
  <Button type="submit">Verify</Button>
</Form>
```

```svelte
<PinCodeInput disabled value="0182" labelText="Verification code" />
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to `true` to use the fluid variant, which embeds the label inside the field. Fluid pin code inputs can be used standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), where the fluid variant is applied automatically. Because fluid segments use an underline affordance rather than boxed fields, empty segments show a placeholder by default so the expected length remains visible. Set `placeholder=""` to remove it, or pass any other string to override the default in either variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput fluid labelText="Verification code" />
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<PinCodeInput fluid labelText="Verification code">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Verification code
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Enter the code sent to your device."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</PinCodeInput>
```

### Bindable value

Bind to `value` for the concatenated code, to `complete` when every segment is filled, or to `code` for per-segment characters. Useful for controlled UI state; for OTP submission, prefer the dispatched change and complete payloads instead of branching on bound values locally.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PinCodeInput, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = "";
  let complete = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <PinCodeInput
    count={4}
    bind:value
    bind:complete
    labelText="Verification code"
  />
  <div>value: {JSON.stringify(value)}</div>
  <div>complete: {complete}</div>
</Stack>
```

### Programmatic usage

Use `bind:this` to obtain a reference to the component instance and call its accessor methods.

| Method | Description | Signature |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focusFirstInput` | Focus the first segment. | `(options?: { selectTextOnFocus?: boolean }) => void` |
| `focusLastInput` | Focus the last segment. | `(options?: { selectTextOnFocus?: boolean }) => void` |
| `focusNextEmptyInput` | Focus the first empty segment, or the last if all are filled. | `(options?: { selectTextOnFocus?: boolean }) => void` |
| `focusNext` | Focus the next segment from the active or last focused one; does not wrap at the last segment. Uses the last focused segment when focus has moved elsewhere (for example, a submit button). | `(options?: { selectTextOnFocus?: boolean }) => void` |
| `clear` | Clear all segments. Focus is not moved by default; pass `{ focus: true }` to focus the first segment afterward. | `(options?: { focus?: boolean }) => void` |

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    PinCodeInput,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let pinCodeInput;
  let value = "018";
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <PinCodeInput
    bind:this={pinCodeInput}
    bind:value
    labelText="Verification code"
  />
  <div>value: {JSON.stringify(value)}</div>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <ButtonSet>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.focusFirstInput()}
      >
        Focus first
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.focusLastInput()}
      >
        Focus last
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.focusNextEmptyInput()}
      >
        Focus next empty
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.focusNext()}
      >
        Focus next
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() =>
          pinCodeInput?.focusFirstInput({ selectTextOnFocus: true })}
      >
        Focus first (select)
      </Button>
    </ButtonSet>
    <ButtonSet>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.clear()}
      >
        Clear
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        on:click={() => pinCodeInput?.clear({ focus: true })}
      >
        Clear (focus)
      </Button>
    </ButtonSet>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### UX example

End-to-end flow using the complete event: normalize the payload, simulate an async verification request, then set invalid / invalidText or show success from the response.

The hardcoded expected code is for demo purposes only. In production, POST the submitted value to your verification API and derive UI state from the server response.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    InlineLoading,
    InlineNotification,
    PinCodeInput,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { onMount } from "svelte";

  // For demo purposes only: NEVER perform local verification of OTP codes.
  const EXPECTED_CODE = "A1B2";
  const VERIFY_DELAY_MS = 400;

  function normalize(value) {
    return value.toUpperCase().replace(/\s/g, "");
  }

  let pinCodeInput;
  let verifyTimeout;
  let loading = $state(false);
  let invalid = $state(false);
  let invalidText = $state("");
  let verified = $state(false);

  function clearVerificationState() {
    if (verifyTimeout) clearTimeout(verifyTimeout);
    loading = false;
    invalid = false;
    invalidText = "";
    verified = false;
  }

  function handleComplete(event) {
    clearVerificationState();
    loading = true;

    verifyTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      loading = false;

      if (normalize(event.detail.value) === normalize(EXPECTED_CODE)) {
        verified = true;
      } else {
        invalid = true;
        invalidText = "The code you entered is incorrect";
      }
    }, VERIFY_DELAY_MS);
  }

  function resetVerification() {
    clearVerificationState();
    pinCodeInput?.clear({ focus: true });
  }

  function handleChange() {
    if (loading) return;
    if (!invalid && !verified) return;
    invalid = false;
    invalidText = "";
    verified = false;
  }

  onMount(() => {
    return () => {
      if (verifyTimeout) clearTimeout(verifyTimeout);
    };
  });
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <PinCodeInput
    bind:this={pinCodeInput}
    type="alphanumeric"
    uppercase
    count={EXPECTED_CODE.length}
    labelText="Invite code"
    helperText="Enter the code sent to your email (try {EXPECTED_CODE})"
    disabled={loading}
    {invalid}
    {invalidText}
    on:complete={handleComplete}
    on:change={handleChange}
    on:clear={clearVerificationState}
  />

  {#if loading}
    <InlineLoading status="active" description="Verifying code..." />
  {:else if verified}
    <InlineNotification
      kind="success"
      title="Code verified"
      subtitle="Your invite code was accepted."
      hideCloseButton
      lowContrast
    />
  {/if}

  <ButtonSet>
    <Button
      kind="tertiary"
      disabled={!verified && !invalid}
      on:click={resetVerification}
    >
      Reset
    </Button>
  </ButtonSet>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `PinCodeInput` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string` | The concatenated code value.<br /><br />Derived from `code` (i.e. `code.join("")`); bind to read the assembled<br />value. When `complete` is `true`, its length equals `count`. Each<br />character matches `pattern` when set, otherwise the active `type`:<br />`0-9` for `"numeric"`, `a-zA-Z0-9` for `"alphanumeric"`. Original casing<br />is preserved regardless of `uppercase`, which only affects the visual<br />rendering. | `""` |
| `code` (Reactive) | `string[]` | The individual segment characters.<br /><br />`code` is the source of truth; its length tracks `count`. Each element is<br />either an empty string (unfilled segment) or a single character matching<br />`pattern` when set, otherwise the active `type`: `0-9` for `"numeric"`,<br />`a-zA-Z0-9` for `"alphanumeric"`. | `[]` |
| `complete` (Reactive) | `boolean` | `true` when every segment is filled. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the outer element. | `null` |
| `count` | `number` | Specify the number of input segments to render | `4` |
| `type` | `"numeric" \| "alphanumeric"` | Specify the type of allowed characters.<br /><br />`"numeric"` allows `0-9`; `"alphanumeric"` allows `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`.<br />Ignored when `pattern` is set. | `"numeric"` |
| `pattern` | `RegExp \| string \| undefined` | Override the per-character validation used for typing and paste.<br /><br />Accepts a `RegExp` or a string compiled with `new RegExp(...)`. The<br />pattern is tested against each individual character, not the full<br />assembled value. When unset, `type` selects the preset (`"numeric"` or<br />`"alphanumeric"`). | _undefined_ |
| `uppercase` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually display the characters in uppercase<br />while retaining the original casing of `value` and `code`.<br /><br />Only affects letters, so it is most useful with `type="alphanumeric"`. | `false` |
| `mask` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mask the segments.<br /><br />Each segment is masked when it is not focused, revealing its character<br />only while focused. | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the input | `false` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "xl"` | Set the size of the input. | `"default"` |
| `light` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the light variant | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `placeholder` | `string \| undefined` | Placeholder shown in empty segments.<br /><br />Defaults to a placeholder in the fluid variant; non-fluid segments have no<br />placeholder unless this prop is set. | _undefined_ |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `required` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark the field as required | `false` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for native form participation.<br /><br />When set, a hidden input mirrors the assembled `value` so the code is<br />included in FormData / form submissions. `required` is applied to the<br />hidden input instead of each segment. | _undefined_ |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |
| `fluid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the fluid variant.<br />Inherited from the parent `FluidForm` context,<br />so it does not need to be set when used inside `FluidForm`. | `false` |
| `selectTextOnFocus` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select a segment's value when it receives focus,<br />including on click. Without this prop, browsers typically select the<br />value only on keyboard focus (for example, via Tab). | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input group | `uniqueId()` |
| `focusFirstInput` | `() => any` | Focus the first input segment. | _undefined_ |
| `focusLastInput` | `() => any` | Focus the last input segment. | _undefined_ |
| `focusNextEmptyInput` | `() => any` | Focus the first empty input segment, or the last if all are filled. | _undefined_ |
| `focusNext` | `() => any` | Focus the next input segment from the currently focused segment.<br />Does not wrap when the last segment is focused. | _undefined_ |
| `clear` | `() => any` | Clear all segments programmatically.<br />By default, focus is not moved. Set `options.focus` to `true` to focus the first segment after clearing. | _undefined_ |

## Popover

### Basic

Create a basic popover with absolute positioning.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  Parent
  <Popover open>Content</Popover>
</div>
```

### Placement

Position the popover relative to its trigger.

#### Relative position

Position the popover relative to its parent with `relative`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  Parent
  <Popover relative open>Content</Popover>
</div>
```

#### Alignment

Customize popover alignment with `align`. Valid values include `"top"`, `"top-left"`, `"top-right"`, `"bottom"`, `"bottom-left"`, `"bottom-right"`, `"left"`, `"left-bottom"`, `"left-top"`, `"right"`, `"right-bottom"`, and `"right-top"`.

The default is top.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={10}>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="top-left">top-left</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="top-right">top-right</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="bottom">bottom</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="bottom-left">bottom-left</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="bottom-right">
      <div>bottom-right</div>
    </Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="left">left</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="left-bottom">left-bottom</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="left-right">left-right</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="right">right</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="right-bottom">right-bottom</Popover>
  </div>
  <div>
    Parent
    <Popover open align="right-top">right-top</Popover>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Caret

### Dismissal

Close the popover automatically, and listen for outside-click interactions.

#### Close on outside click

Close the popover when clicking outside with `closeOnOutsideClick`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  Parent
  <Popover
    open
    closeOnOutsideClick
    on:click:outside={() => {
      console.log("on:click:outside");
    }}
  >
    Content
  </Popover>
</div>
```

#### Events

`on:click:outside` fires whenever a click lands outside the popover, with `event.detail.target` set to the clicked element--regardless of whether `closeOnOutsideClick` is set. `on:close` fires only when the popover closes itself in response to `closeOnOutsideClick`, with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"outside-click"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  Parent
  <Popover
    open
    closeOnOutsideClick
    on:click:outside={(e) => console.log("on:click:outside", e.detail)}
    on:close={(e) => console.log("on:close", e.detail)}
  >
    Content
  </Popover>
</div>
```

### External element

Manage open state with an external element, like a button, using `open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Popover } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
  let ref = null;
</script>

<div bind:this={ref} style:position="relative">
  <Button on:click={() => (open = !open)}>Toggle popover</Button>
  <Popover
    bind:open
    align="bottom-left"
    on:click:outside={({ detail }) => {
      console.log("on:click:outside");
      open = ref.contains(detail.target);
    }}
  >
    Content
  </Popover>
</div>
```

### Component API

#### `Popover` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the popover. | `false` |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to close the popover on an outside click | `false` |
| `caret` | `boolean` | Set to `true` render a caret | `false` |
| `align` | `"top" \| "top-left" \| "top-right" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-left" \| "bottom-right" \| "left" \| "left-bottom" \| "left-top" \| "right" \| "right-bottom" \| "right-top"` | Specify the alignment of the caret. | `"top"` |
| `light` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the light variant | `false` |
| `highContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the high contrast variant | `false` |
| `relative` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use a relative position | `false` |

#### `Popover` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Popover` dispatched events

| Event              | Detail                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `on:click:outside` | `{<br />  target: HTMLElement;<br />}`      |
| `on:close`         | `{<br />  trigger: "outside-click";<br />}` |

#### `Popover` $$restProps

`Popover` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Portal

### Basic

Render content in a portal -- useful for modals, tooltips, and menus that need to escape parent containers. For anchored, positioned content (dropdowns, popovers, overflow menus), use [FloatingPortal](/components/FloatingPortal) instead.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Portal } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div>
  <div>This is rendered inside the div</div>
  <br />
  <Portal>This is rendered outside of the div</Portal>
</div>
```

### Multiple portals

Each portal instance is independent, creating its own element in document.body, and is automatically cleaned up when removed.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet, Portal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let showPortal1 = false;
  let showPortal2 = false;
</script>

<ButtonSet>
  <Button on:click={() => (showPortal1 = !showPortal1)}>
    {showPortal1 ? "Unmount portal 1" : "Mount portal 1"}
  </Button>
  <Button on:click={() => (showPortal2 = !showPortal2)}>
    {showPortal2 ? "Unmount portal 2" : "Mount portal 2"}
  </Button>
</ButtonSet>

{#if showPortal1}
  <Portal>Portal content 1</Portal>
{/if}

{#if showPortal2}
  <Portal>Portal content 2</Portal>
{/if}
```

### Custom tag

The portal renders a div by default. Set `tag` to specify a custom HTML element.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Portal } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Portal tag="section">This portal uses a section tag.</Portal>
```

### Modal with portal

Wrap the modal in a portal to escape parent containers with overflow hidden or z-index stacking contexts. This ensures the modal appears above all content and is not clipped by parent boundaries.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, Portal, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={5} style="overflow: hidden; position: relative; height: 200px;">
  <p>
    This container hides overflowing content. Without a portal, the modal would
    be clipped.
  </p>
  <div><Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button></div>
  <Portal>
    <Modal
      bind:open
      modalHeading="Modal in Portal"
      primaryButtonText="Confirm"
      secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
      on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
    >
      <p>
        This modal is rendered in a portal, escaping the parent container's
        overflow constraints and ensuring it appears above all other content.
      </p>
    </Modal>
  </Portal>
</Stack>
```

### Custom target

Mount the portal into a specific DOM element instead of document.body with `target`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Portal, Stack, Tile } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let target = null;
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <Tile>
    <div>Portal is declared here.</div>
    <Portal {target}><strong>Portalled content</strong></Portal>
  </Tile>
  <Tile>
    <div bind:this={target}>
      But mounted into this container via <code>target</code>.
    </div>
  </Tile>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Portal` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLElement` | Obtain a reference to the portal element. | `null` |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the tag name. | `"div"` |
| `target` | `HTMLElement \| null` | Specify the DOM element to mount the portal into.<br />Defaults to `document.body`. | `null` |

#### `Portal` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Portal` $$restProps

`Portal` spreads `$$restProps` to the `svelte:element` element.


## ProgressBar

### Basic

Create an indeterminate progress bar that continuously animates. A progress bar is indeterminate when `value` is left `undefined` while `status` is `"active"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar helperText="Loading..." />
```

### Value

#### Percentage

Display progress as a percentage with `value`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  value={40}
  labelText="Upload status"
  helperText="40 MB of 100 MB"
/>
```

#### Custom max value

Set a custom maximum value for the progress bar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  value={40}
  max={200}
  labelText="Upload status"
  helperText="40 MB of 200 MB"
/>
```

### Label

#### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  hideLabel
  value={40}
  labelText="Upload status"
  helperText="40 MB of 100 MB"
/>
```

#### Custom label content

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar value={40} helperText="40 MB of 100 MB">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Upload status
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Files are scanned before upload completes."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</ProgressBar>
```

### Size

Use the small size variant for compact layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar size="sm" helperText="Loading..." />
```

### Status

Reflect operation outcome with `status`.

#### Finished

Show completion status with a checkmark icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  value={100}
  status="finished"
  labelText="Upload file"
  helperText="Upload complete"
/>
```

#### Error

Indicate errors with an error icon and red styling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  value={0}
  status="error"
  labelText="Upload file"
  helperText="Invalid file format"
/>
```

### Variants

Change layout with `kind`.

#### Inline

Use the inline variant to display progress without helper text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  kind="inline"
  value={40}
  labelText="Upload status"
  helperText="40 MB of 100 MB"
/>
```

#### Indented

Use the indented variant for a more compact layout.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  kind="indented"
  value={40}
  labelText="Upload status"
  helperText="40 MB of 100 MB"
/>
```

#### Indented (status)

Combine the indented variant with status indicators.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressBar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressBar
  kind="indented"
  status="finished"
  value={40}
  labelText="Upload file"
  helperText="Upload complete"
/>
```

### UX example

Demonstrate a complete upload flow with start and end states.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    ProgressBar,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let max = 328;
  let value = 0;
  let status = "active";

  $: helperText =
    value > 0 ? `${value.toFixed(0)}MB of ${max}MB` : "Press start";
  $: if (value === max) {
    helperText = "Done";
    status = "finished";
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={8}>
  <ProgressBar labelText="Upload status" {value} {max} {helperText} {status} />
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button
      disabled={value > 0}
      on:click={() => {
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
          const delta = Math.random() * 10;

          if (value + delta < max) {
            value += delta;
          } else {
            value = max;
            clearInterval(interval);
          }
        }, 30);
      }}
    >
      Start
    </Button>
    <Button
      kind="tertiary"
      disabled={value !== max}
      on:click={() => {
        value = 0;
        status = "active";
      }}
    >
      Reset
    </Button>
  </ButtonSet>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ProgressBar` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Specify the current value. | _undefined_ |
| `max` | `number` | Specify the maximum value | `100` |
| `kind` | `"default" \| "inline" \| "indented"` | Specify the kind of progress bar. | `"default"` |
| `status` | `"active" \| "finished" \| "error"` | Specify the status. | `"active"` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | Specify the size. | `"md"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the progress bar element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ProgressBar` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ProgressBar` $$restProps

`ProgressBar` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ProgressIndicator

### Basic

Create a horizontal progress indicator with four steps.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={2}>
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 1"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 2"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 3"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    label="Step 4"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

### Step selection

Control which step is active, and how clicking a step affects that selection.

#### Selected by id

For dynamic step sets, bind `selectedId` and give each `ProgressStep` a stable `id`. Selection stays on the same logical step when steps before it are added or removed. When set, `selectedId` takes precedence over `currentIndex`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    ProgressIndicator,
    ProgressStep,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedId = "step-b";
  let showStepA = true;
  let showStepB = true;
  let showStepC = true;
  let showStepD = true;

  $: visibleSteps = [
    { id: "step-a", label: "Step 1", show: showStepA },
    { id: "step-b", label: "Step 2", show: showStepB },
    { id: "step-c", label: "Step 3", show: showStepC },
    { id: "step-d", label: "Step 4", show: showStepD },
  ].filter((s) => s.show);
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <div>
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showStepA} labelText="Show Step 1" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showStepB} labelText="Show Step 2" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showStepC} labelText="Show Step 3" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showStepD} labelText="Show Step 4" />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4} orientation="horizontal" align="center">
    <Button
      kind="tertiary"
      size="small"
      on:click={() => (selectedId = "step-c")}
    >
      Select Step 3 by id
    </Button>
    <div><strong>selectedId:</strong> {selectedId}</div>
  </Stack>
  <ProgressIndicator bind:selectedId>
    {#each visibleSteps as step (step.id)}
      <ProgressStep id={step.id} label={step.label} complete />
    {/each}
  </ProgressIndicator>
</Stack>
```

#### Programmatic usage

Update the current step programmatically while maintaining step completion rules. Bind to a step's `current` prop to read whether it's the active step.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ProgressIndicator,
    ProgressStep,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let currentIndex = 1;
  let thirdStepCurrent = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <ProgressIndicator bind:currentIndex>
    <ProgressStep
      complete
      label="Step 1"
      description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
    />
    <ProgressStep
      complete
      label="Step 2"
      description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
    />
    <ProgressStep
      complete
      bind:current={thirdStepCurrent}
      label="Step 3"
      description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
    />
    <ProgressStep
      label="Step 4"
      description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
    />
  </ProgressIndicator>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>
      <Button
        kind={currentIndex === 2 ? "secondary" : "primary"}
        size="small"
        on:click={() => {
          currentIndex = currentIndex === 2 ? 0 : 2;
        }}
      >
        Set currentIndex to
        {currentIndex === 2 ? 0 : 2}
      </Button>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Current index:</strong>
      {currentIndex}
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Is the third step currently selected?</strong>
      {thirdStepCurrent}
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Prevent change on click

Disable automatic step selection when clicking completed steps.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator preventChangeOnClick currentIndex={2}>
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 1"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 2"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 3"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    label="Step 4"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

### Step content

Customize what renders inside a step, beyond the default label and icon.

#### Icon (slot)

Override the default step icon using the `icon` named slot. The slot exposes complete, current, invalid, and description so the override can mirror the step state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CheckmarkFilled from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CheckmarkFilled.svelte";
  import Circle from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Circle.svelte";
  import InProgress from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/InProgress.svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep complete label="Step 1" description="Completed step">
    <CheckmarkFilled slot="icon" />
  </ProgressStep>
  <ProgressStep label="Step 2" description="Current step">
    <InProgress slot="icon" />
  </ProgressStep>
  <ProgressStep label="Step 3" description="Upcoming step">
    <Circle slot="icon" />
  </ProgressStep>
</ProgressIndicator>
```

#### Label (slot)

Override the default label using the default slot instead of `label`. The slot exposes `props`, which includes the `class` needed to keep the label styled correctly.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep complete let:props description="Completed step">
    <strong class={props.class}>Step 1</strong>
  </ProgressStep>
  <ProgressStep let:props description="Current step">
    <strong class={props.class}>Step 2</strong>
  </ProgressStep>
  <ProgressStep let:props description="Upcoming step">
    <strong class={props.class}>Step 3</strong>
  </ProgressStep>
</ProgressIndicator>
```

#### Secondary label

Set `secondaryLabel` to display supplementary text after the label, such as marking a step as optional.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep complete label="Step 1" description="Completed step" />
  <ProgressStep
    label="Step 2"
    description="Current step"
    secondaryLabel="Optional"
  />
  <ProgressStep label="Step 3" description="Upcoming step" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

### Events

Respond to step selection changes.

Use `on:change` to listen for the step becoming active, either from a completed step being clicked or from `currentIndex`/`selectedId` being updated. The event dispatches the new step index as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProgressIndicator
  currentIndex={0}
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // number
>
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 1"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    complete
    label="Step 2"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
  <ProgressStep
    label="Step 3"
    description="The progress indicator will listen for clicks on the steps"
  />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

### Component API

#### `ProgressIndicator` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string \| undefined` | Specify the current step by id.<br />When set, takes precedence over `currentIndex` and stays on the same<br />logical step as steps are added or removed. Pair with a stable `id` on<br />each `ProgressStep`. | _undefined_ |

| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

| ----------- | -------- |
| `on:change` | `number` |

#### `ProgressIndicator` $$restProps

#### `ProgressStep` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |

| `complete` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the complete variant | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the progress step | `false` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `description` | `string` | Specify the step description | `""` |
| `label` | `string` | Specify the step label | `""` |
| `secondaryLabel` | `string` | Specify the step secondary label | `""` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ProgressStep` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |

| `count` | `number` | Specify the number of steps to render | `4` |

## RadioButton

### Basic

Create a group of radio buttons with a shared name and legend.

See [Standalone usage](#standalone-usage) for individual usage or [Implicit grouping](#implicit-grouping) to group multiple standalone radio buttons by name without using a radio button group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Standalone usage

Use a radio button individually with bindable checked state for simple use cases.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, RadioButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let agreedToTerms = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Stack align="start">
    <RadioButton
      bind:checked={agreedToTerms}
      labelText="I agree to the terms and conditions"
      name="terms"
      value="agreed"
    />
  </Stack>
  <div>
    <Button
      size="small"
      kind="secondary"
      disabled={!agreedToTerms}
      on:click={() => (agreedToTerms = !agreedToTerms)}
    >
      Reset
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Implicit grouping

Multiple standalone radio buttons sharing the same name automatically form a group and synchronize their checked state -- no radio button group component required.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const options = [
    { value: "option1", label: "Option 1" },
    { value: "option2", label: "Option 2" },
    { value: "option3", label: "Option 3" },
  ];

  let checked = options.map(() => false);

  $: selected = options.find((_, i) => checked[i]);
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal">
    {#each options as option, i}
      <RadioButton
        bind:checked={checked[i]}
        value={option.value}
        labelText={option.label}
        name="implicit-group"
      />
    {/each}
  </Stack>

  <span>
    Selected:
    <strong>{selected?.label ?? "None"}</strong>
  </span>
</Stack>
```

### Reactive

Bind and update the selected value programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const plans = ["Free (1 GB)", "Standard (10 GB)", "Pro (128 GB)"];

  let plan = plans[1];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <RadioButtonGroup
    legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
    name="plan"
    bind:selected={plan}
  >
    {#each plans as value (value)}
      <RadioButton labelText={value} {value} />
    {/each}
  </RadioButtonGroup>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>
      {#each plans as value (value)}
        <Button
          size="small"
          kind="secondary"
          disabled={plan === value}
          on:click={() => (plan = value)}
        >
          Select "{value}"
        </Button>
      {/each}
    </div>
    <div>
      Selected plan:
      <strong>{plan}</strong>
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Labels and legend

Control the visibility and content of individual radio button labels and the group legend.

#### Hidden legend

```svelte
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup

  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-legend"
  selected="standard"
>

  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Hidden label

Hide an individual radio button's label text by setting `hideLabel` to `true` on `RadioButton`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButton labelText="Label text" hideLabel />
```

#### Custom label

```svelte
    RadioButton,

    </Tooltip>
  </Stack>

  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

## RadioTile

### Basic

Create a group of radio tiles with a shared name and legend.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup legendText="Service pricing tiers" name="plan" selected="standard">
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Reactive

#### One-way binding

Update the selected value using the `select` event.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const values = ["Lite plan", "Standard plan", "Plus plan"];

  let selected = values[1];
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan"
  on:select={({ detail }) => (selected = detail)}
>
  {#each values as value}
    <RadioTile {value} checked={selected === value}>{value}</RadioTile>
  {/each}
</TileGroup>

<br />
Selected: <strong>{selected}</strong>
```

#### Two-way binding

Bind to `selected` for simpler state management.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    RadioTile,
    Stack,
    TileGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const values = ["Lite plan", "Standard plan", "Plus plan"];

  let selected = values[1];
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <TileGroup legendText="Service pricing tiers" name="plan" bind:selected>
    {#each values as value}
      <RadioTile {value}>{value}</RadioTile>
    {/each}
  </TileGroup>
  <div>Selected: <strong>{selected}</strong></div>
  <Button
    size="small"
    disabled={selected === values[1]}
    on:click={() => (selected = values[1])}
  >
    Set to "{values[1]}"
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Legend

Use the `legendChildren` slot on `TileGroup` to provide custom legend content instead of `legendText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup name="plan-legend-slot" selected="standard">
  <strong slot="legendChildren">Service pricing tiers</strong>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Light

Use the light variant for light backgrounds.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-light"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile light value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile light value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile light value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Disabled

Disable specific tiles, or the entire group, to prevent selection.

#### Individual tiles

Disable specific tiles to prevent selection.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-disabled"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile value="lite" disabled>Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus" disabled>Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

#### Entire group

Disable every tile at once by setting `disabled` on `TileGroup`. This prevents selection natively through the underlying `fieldset`, but doesn't apply the muted disabled tile styling shown above--set `disabled` on each `RadioTile` too for the visual state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-disabled-group"
  selected="standard"
  disabled
>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Checkmark label

Customize the ARIA label announced for a tile's checkmark icon with `iconDescription`. Defaults to `"Tile checkmark"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-checkmark-label"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard" iconDescription="Standard plan selected">
    Standard plan
  </RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

## RecursiveList

### Basic

Create a hierarchical list using the `nodes` prop. Each node can contain text, links, nested children, and HTML content via the html prop (which is not sanitized).

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    {
      text: "Item 1",
      nodes: [
        {
          text: "Item 1a",
          nodes: [{ html: "<h5>HTML content</h5>" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 2",
      nodes: [
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
        },
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
          text: "Link with custom text",
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 3",
    },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList {nodes} />
```

### Link attributes

Set `target` on a node to control where a link opens. When `target` is `"_blank"`, `rel` defaults to `"noopener noreferrer"`; supply `rel` explicitly to override it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    {
      text: "Opens in a new tab",
      href: "https://svelte.dev/",
      target: "_blank",
    },
    {
      text: "Custom rel",
      href: "https://svelte.dev/",
      rel: "nofollow",
    },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList {nodes} />
```

### Ordered

Set `type` to `"ordered"` for numbered lists with proper indentation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    {
      text: "Item 1",
      nodes: [
        {
          text: "Item 1a",
          nodes: [{ html: "<h5>HTML content</h5>" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 2",
      nodes: [
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
        },
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
          text: "Link with custom text",
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 3",
    },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList type="ordered" {nodes} />
```

#### Native styles

Set `type` to `"ordered-native"` for browser-native numbering styles.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    {
      text: "Item 1",
      nodes: [
        {
          text: "Item 1a",
          nodes: [{ html: "<h5>HTML content</h5>" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 2",
      nodes: [
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
        },
        {
          href: "https://svelte.dev/",
          text: "Link with custom text",
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 3",
    },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList type="ordered-native" {nodes} />
```

### Expressive styles

Use Carbon's expressive typesetting with `expressive`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    {
      text: "Item 1",
      nodes: [
        {
          text: "Item 1a",
          nodes: [{ text: "Item 1a-i" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: "Item 2",
      nodes: [{ text: "Item 2a" }],
    },
    { text: "Item 3" },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList expressive {nodes} />
```

### Flat data

Convert flat data to hierarchical arrays with the `toHierarchy` utility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList, toHierarchy } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodesFlat = [
    { id: 1, text: "Item 1" },
    { id: 2, text: "Item 1a", pid: 1 },
    { id: 3, html: "<h5>HTML content</h5>", pid: 2 },
    { id: 4, text: "Item 2" },
    { id: 5, href: "https://svelte.dev/", pid: 4 },
    {
      id: 6,
      href: "https://svelte.dev/",
      text: "Link with custom text",
      pid: 4,
    },
    { id: 7, text: "Item 3" },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList nodes={toHierarchy(nodesFlat, (node) => node.pid)} />
```

### Stable keys

Each node accepts an optional id (string or number) used as the each-block key. Supply an id when text or href values can repeat, so reordering or filtering preserves DOM identity.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const nodes = [
    { id: "intro", text: "Introduction" },
    { id: "guide", text: "Guide", nodes: [{ id: "guide-1", text: "Setup" }] },
    { id: "api", text: "API reference" },
  ];
</script>

<RecursiveList {nodes} />
```

---

### Component API

#### `RecursiveList` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `ReadonlyArray<Node & { nodes?: Node[] }>` | Specify the nodes to render. | `[]` |
| `type` | `"unordered" \| "ordered" \| "ordered-native"` | Specify the type of list to render. | `"unordered"` |
| `expressive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting | `false` |

#### `RecursiveList` typedefs

```ts
type RecursiveListNode = {
  /** Unique node identifier; used as the each-block key when provided */
  id?: string | number;
  /** Node text content */
  text?: string;
  /** Node link URL */
  href?: string;
  /** Node HTML content */
  html?: string;
  /** Node link target */
  target?: import("svelte/elements").SvelteHTMLElements["a"]["target"];
  /** Node link rel */
  rel?: import("svelte/elements").SvelteHTMLElements["a"]["rel"];
  /** Child nodes */
  nodes?: RecursiveListNode[];
};
```

#### `RecursiveList` $$restProps

`RecursiveList` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul | ol` element.


## Search

### Basic

The search input is extra-large by default. Set `size` to choose another variant -- see [large](#large), [small](#small), and [extra-small](#extra-small). The input clears on <kbd>Escape</kbd> or the clear button.

To build a search typeahead with a results menu -- suggestions, grouped results, and recent searches -- use [SearchMenu](/components/SearchMenu), which composes `Search`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Search } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Search />
```

### Initial value

Set an initial value with `value`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Search } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Search placeholder="Search catalog..." value="Cloud functions" />
```

### Reactive example

Bind to `value` for reactive updates.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet, Search, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = "";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Search bind:value />
  <div>
    <ButtonSet>
      <Button
        size="small"
        disabled={value === "Cloud functions"}
        on:click={() => (value = "Cloud functions")}
      >
        Set value
      </Button>
      <Button
        kind="ghost"
        size="small"
        disabled={value.length === 0}
        on:click={() => (value = "")}
      >
        Clear value
      </Button>
    </ButtonSet>
  </div>
  <div>Value: {value}</div>
</Stack>
```

### Clear event

The `clear` event fires when clicking the clear button or pressing <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Search } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Search value="Cloud functions" on:clear={() => console.log("clear")} />

## Custom labels Customize the ARIA labels used for accessibility. ### Landmark
label The outer element has `role="search"`, and its accessible name comes from
`labelText` via `aria-labelledby`, not a static `aria-label`. The label is
visually hidden by default -- see [Fluid](#fluid) for the variant with a visible
label. Always set a descriptive `labelText`, especially when a page has more
than one search region, so screen reader users can distinguish each landmark by
name.

<Search labelText="Search catalog" />

### Close button label Set `closeButtonLabelText` to customize the accessible
label of the clear button (default `"Clear search input"`).

<Search value="Cloud functions" closeButtonLabelText="Clear catalog search" />

## Expandable Enable the expandable variant to show a compact search icon that
expands on focus. While collapsed, the input is marked `inert` and removed from
the tab order, hiding it from assistive technology until it expands -- only the
search icon button is reachable.
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Search } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let expanded = false;
</script>

<Search expandable bind:expanded on:expand on:collapse />

<br />

<strong>Expanded:</strong>
{expanded}
```

```svelte
<Search light />
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to embed a visible label inside the field. Fluid search inputs work standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), which applies the variant automatically. The fluid variant has a fixed height and cannot be combined with the expandable variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Search } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Search fluid labelText="Search catalog" placeholder="Search services..." />
```

```svelte
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<Search fluid labelText="Search catalog" placeholder="Search services...">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Search catalog
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Search applies to services in the selected region only."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</Search>
```
