### Component API

#### `Tag` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement \| HTMLButtonElement \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the outer HTML element. | `null` |
| `type` | `"red" \| "magenta" \| "purple" \| "blue" \| "cyan" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "gray" \| "cool-gray" \| "warm-gray" \| "high-contrast" \| "outline"` | Specify the type of tag. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | Specify the size of the tag.<br />Defaults to `"default"`, or to the `size` of a parent `TagSet`. | _undefined_ |
| `filter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use filterable variant | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable a filterable tag | `false` |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a `button` element instead of a `div` | `false` |
| `href` | `string` | Specify the `href` attribute to render the tag as an anchor.<br />Mutually exclusive with `filter`; when both are set, `filter` takes precedence. | _undefined_ |
| `skeleton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the skeleton state | `false` |
| `inline` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to omit the default outer margin | `false` |
| `title` | `string` | Set the title for the close button in a filterable tag | `"Clear filter"` |
| `maxWidth` | `string \| undefined` | Cap the tag width. When the label overflows, a tooltip shows the full text.<br />Accepts any CSS length (for example `"8rem"`, `"120px"`). | _undefined_ |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the filterable tag | `uniqueId()` |

#### `Tag` slots

| Slot      | Detail                                                |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `default` | `{<br />  props: { class: "bx--tag__label" };<br />}` |
| `icon`    | `Record<string, never>`                               |

| --------------- |

| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Tag` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:close` | `null` |

#### `Tag` $$restProps

`Tag` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div | button | a` element.

#### `SelectableTag` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the tag. | `false` |
| `type` | `"red" \| "magenta" \| "purple" \| "blue" \| "cyan" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "gray" \| "cool-gray" \| "warm-gray" \| "high-contrast" \| "outline"` | Specify the type of tag. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "default"` |  | `"default"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the tag | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the tag | `uniqueId()` |

`SelectableTag` spreads `$$restProps` to the `button` element.

#### `TagSkeleton` props

| Prop   | Type                        | Description | Default     |
| ------ | --------------------------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` |             | `"default"` |

| --------------- |

`TagSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span` element.


## TagSet

### Basic

Compose `TagSet` from ordinary `Tag` children. `TagSet` measures the available width and shows as many as fit.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet>
  <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Alignment

Set `align` to change how the visible tags are positioned within the row when they don't fill the available width.

#### Center

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet align="center">
  <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

#### End

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet align="end">
  <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Overflow

Once the row runs out of space, the remaining tags collapse into a "+N" indicator. Hovering it shows the hidden labels in a tooltip.

There is no fixed number of tags that triggers this. `TagSet` measures the actual pixel width available and fits as many tags as space allows, so the count that overflows depends on the container's width and each tag's label length, not a set threshold.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const frameworks = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
    { label: "Ember", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Preact", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Solid", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Qwik", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Lit", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "Alpine", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<div style="max-width: 20rem;">
  <TagSet>
    {#each frameworks as framework}
      <Tag type={framework.type}>{framework.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

#### Max visible

Set `maxVisible` to cap the number of visible tags regardless of how much space is available.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const frameworks = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
    { label: "Ember", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Preact", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Solid", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Qwik", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Lit", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "Alpine", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<div style="max-width: 20rem;">
  <TagSet maxVisible={3}>
    {#each frameworks as framework}
      <Tag type={framework.type}>{framework.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

#### Multiline

Set `multiline` to wrap every tag onto multiple lines instead of collapsing into an overflow indicator.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const frameworks = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
    { label: "Ember", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Preact", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Solid", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Qwik", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Lit", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "Alpine", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<div style="max-width: 20rem;">
  <TagSet multiline>
    {#each frameworks as framework}
      <Tag type={framework.type}>{framework.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

#### Measurement offset

Set `measurementOffset` to subtract a fixed amount from the measured available width before fitting tags -- useful when other content shares the same row and should be reserved space.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <div>measurementOffset={0} (default)</div>
    <div style="max-width: 14rem;">
      <TagSet>
        <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>measurementOffset={80}</div>
    <div style="max-width: 14rem;">
      <TagSet measurementOffset={80}>
        <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </div>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Custom measurement target

Set `containingElement` to measure a different element instead of `TagSet`'s own wrapper -- useful when the width `TagSet` should fit within isn't its own box, for example when matching the width of another element on the page.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  // An empty reference element whose width TagSet should fit within,
  // instead of its own (wider) wrapper -- for example, to match the width
  // of an unrelated column elsewhere on the page.
  let target;
</script>

<div style="max-width: 20rem;">
  <div bind:this={target} style="max-width: 8rem;"></div>
  <TagSet containingElement={target}>
    <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

### Overflow tooltip

Control the content and positioning of the tooltip shown by the "+N" indicator.

#### Alignment

Set `overflowAlign` to align the tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <div>overflowAlign="start"</div>
    <div style="max-width: 12rem;">
      <TagSet overflowAlign="start">
        <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>overflowAlign="end"</div>
    <div style="max-width: 12rem;">
      <TagSet overflowAlign="end">
        <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </div>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Direction

Set `overflowDirection` to `"top"` to show the tooltip above the indicator instead of below.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style="max-width: 12rem;">
  <TagSet overflowDirection="top">
    <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

#### Custom content

Override the `overflowTooltip` slot to replace the default plain-text tooltip with custom content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const frameworks = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
    { label: "Ember", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Preact", type: "cyan" },
  ];
</script>

<div style="max-width: 12rem;">
  <TagSet>
    {#each frameworks as framework}
      <Tag type={framework.type}>{framework.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
    <svelte:fragment slot="overflowTooltip" let:tags let:count>
      <strong>{count} more:</strong>&nbsp;{tags
        .map((tag) => tag.label)
        .join(", ")}
    </svelte:fragment>
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

### Dismissible

Set `filter` on a `Tag` to render it as closable. `TagSet` dispatches `close:tag` with `{ tag, index }` instead of taking a per-tag handler: remove the tag from your own state in response.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let tags = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
  ];

  function handleTagClose({ detail }) {
    tags = tags.filter((_, index) => index !== detail.index);
  }
</script>

<TagSet on:close:tag={handleTagClose}>
  {#each tags as tag}
    <Tag type={tag.type} filter>{tag.label}</Tag>
  {/each}
</TagSet>
```

### Events

Respond to interactions with the "+N" overflow indicator.

#### Overflow click

Use `on:click:overflow` to listen for clicks on the "+N" indicator. The event detail includes the current overflow count.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style="max-width: 12rem;">
  <TagSet on:click:overflow={(e) => console.log(e.detail.count)}>
    <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

#### Overflow count change

Use `on:overflow:change` to listen for changes to the overflow count, whether from a resize, a slotted-children change, or a `maxVisible` change. The event detail includes the new count.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style="max-width: 12rem;">
  <TagSet on:overflow:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail.count)}>
    <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">Vue</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Ember</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</div>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` on `TagSet` to apply it to every slotted tag (including the "+N" overflow indicator) that doesn't set its own `size`.

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet size="sm">
  <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet size="lg">
  <Tag type="red">Angular</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">React</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Svelte</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Gap

Set `gap` to control the spacing between tags. Accepts a Carbon layout scale (`0`-`13`) or a CSS length string.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const frameworks = [
    { label: "Angular", type: "red" },
    { label: "React", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Svelte", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Vue", type: "green" },
  ];
</script>

<TagSet gap="1.5rem">
  {#each frameworks as framework}
    <Tag type={framework.type}>{framework.label}</Tag>
  {/each}
</TagSet>
```

---

### Component API

#### `TagSet` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Horizontal alignment of the visible tag row. | `"start"` |
| `overflowAlign` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Alignment of the overflow tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator. | `"center"` |
| `overflowDirection` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Direction of the overflow tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator. | `"bottom"` |
| `maxVisible` | `number \| undefined` | Hard cap on visible tags regardless of available space. | _undefined_ |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to wrap all tags instead of collapsing to overflow. | `false` |
| `measurementOffset` | `number` | Subtracted from the measured available width before fitting tags. | `0` |
| `containingElement` | `HTMLElement \| undefined` | Custom element to measure instead of `TagSet`'s own wrapper. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | Size of every tag, including the "+N" overflow indicator. Applies to<br />slotted `Tag` children without their own `size`. | _undefined_ |
| `gap` | `import("../Stack/Stack.svelte").StackScale \| string` | Spacing between tags. Accepts a Carbon layout scale (`0`-`13`) or a CSS<br />length string. | `3` |

#### `TagSet` typedefs

```ts
type TagSetItem = {
  id: string;
  node: HTMLElement;
  label: string;
  type?: string;
  size: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  filter: boolean;
};
```

#### `TagSet` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `overflowTooltip` | `{<br />  tags: TagSetItem[];<br />  count: number;<br />}` |

#### `TagSet` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:click:overflow` | `{ count: number }` | User clicks the "+N" indicator. |
| `on:close:tag` | `{<br />  tag: TagSetItem;<br />  index: number;<br />}` | User clicks the close icon on a dismissible (`filter`) tag. |
| `on:overflow:change` | `{ count: number }` | Dispatched when the number of overflowing tags changes, from a resize, a slotted-children change, or a `maxVisible` change. |

#### `TagSet` $$restProps

`TagSet` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Text

### Basic

The default component renders a `<p>` with the body-long-01 type style.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text>Carbon Components Svelte implements the Carbon Design System.</Text>
```

### Text color

Set `color` to a Carbon semantic text token. Each token describes intent and resolves to the active theme, so colors update when the theme changes.

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | Primary text for headings and body copy |
| `secondary` | Secondary text for supplementary copy |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder text in form inputs |
| `helper` | Helper and caption text |
| `on-color` | Text on a colored background, such as a button or tag |
| `inverse` | Text on an inverse surface, such as a tooltip or notification |
| `error` | Error and validation text |
| `disabled` | Disabled text |

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text color="primary">Primary text</Text>
<Text color="secondary">Secondary text</Text>
<Text color="placeholder">Placeholder text</Text>
<Text color="helper">Helper text</Text>
<Text color="error">Error text</Text>
<Text color="disabled">Disabled text</Text>
```

On-color and inverse tokens are meant for colored or inverse surfaces, where the default text tokens would be unreadable. Both read light in the white theme but track different surfaces, so they diverge in other themes. Each example places the token on the surface it is designed for.

Use `on-color` for text on a colored background, such as a button or tag fill. [Box](/components/Box) has no fill token for interactive surfaces, so set the background on the container:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box padding={5} style="background-color: var(--cds-interactive-01)">
  <Text color="on-color">Text on a colored background</Text>
</Box>
```

Use `inverse` for text on an inverse surface, such as a tooltip or notification:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box fill="inverse" padding={5}>
  <Text color="inverse">Text on an inverse surface</Text>
</Box>
```

### Type styles

Set `type` to a Carbon type token. The scale covers supporting text, body copy, and the productive and expressive heading sets. Productive styles use fixed sizes for dense product UI; expressive styles scale fluidly with the viewport for editorial layouts.

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `caption-01` | Smallest supporting text for captions and footnotes |
| `caption-02` | Caption text, one step larger |
| `label-01` | Form field and UI labels |
| `label-02` | Label text, one step larger |
| `helper-text-01` | Helper text beneath form inputs |
| `helper-text-02` | Helper text, one step larger |
| `body-short-01` | Dense, single-line body text |
| `body-short-02` | Dense body text, one step larger |
| `body-long-01` | Paragraph body text for multiple lines |
| `body-long-02` | Paragraph body text, one step larger |
| `code-01` | Inline code set in IBM Plex Mono |
| `code-02` | Code text, one step larger |
| `heading-01` | Bold heading for dense UI |
| `heading-02` | Bold heading, one step larger |
| `productive-heading-01` | Productive heading scale, step 1 (smallest) |
| `productive-heading-02` | Productive heading scale, step 2 |
| `productive-heading-03` | Productive heading scale, step 3 |
| `productive-heading-04` | Productive heading scale, step 4 |
| `productive-heading-05` | Productive heading scale, step 5 |
| `productive-heading-06` | Productive heading scale, step 6 (light weight) |
| `productive-heading-07` | Productive heading scale, step 7 (largest, light weight) |
| `expressive-paragraph-01` | Fluid paragraph for editorial layouts |
| `expressive-heading-01` | Expressive heading, step 1 |
| `expressive-heading-02` | Expressive heading, step 2 |
| `expressive-heading-03` | Expressive heading, fluid above step 2 |
| `expressive-heading-04` | Expressive heading, fluid |
| `expressive-heading-05` | Expressive heading, fluid |
| `expressive-heading-06` | Expressive heading, fluid (largest) |
| `quotation-01` | Fluid quotation set in IBM Plex Serif |
| `quotation-02` | Quotation, one step larger |
| `display-01` | Largest fluid display text |
| `display-02` | Display text, fluid |
| `display-03` | Display text, fluid |
| `display-04` | Display text, fluid (largest) |

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="caption-01">Caption 01</Text>
<Text type="caption-02">Caption 02</Text>
<Text type="label-01">Label 01</Text>
<Text type="label-02">Label 02</Text>
<Text type="helper-text-01">Helper text 01</Text>
<Text type="helper-text-02">Helper text 02</Text>
<Text type="body-short-01">Body short 01</Text>
<Text type="body-short-02">Body short 02</Text>
<Text type="body-long-01">Body long 01</Text>
<Text type="body-long-02">Body long 02</Text>
<Text tag="code" type="code-01">const carbon = "components-svelte";</Text>
<Text tag="pre" type="code-02">const carbon = "components-svelte";</Text>
<Text tag="h6" type="heading-01">Heading 01</Text>
<Text tag="h5" type="heading-02">Heading 02</Text>
<Text tag="h6" type="productive-heading-01">Productive heading 01</Text>
<Text tag="h5" type="productive-heading-02">Productive heading 02</Text>
<Text tag="h4" type="productive-heading-03">Productive heading 03</Text>
<Text tag="h3" type="productive-heading-04">Productive heading 04</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="productive-heading-05">Productive heading 05</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="productive-heading-06">Productive heading 06</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="productive-heading-07">Productive heading 07</Text>
<Text type="expressive-paragraph-01">Expressive paragraph 01</Text>
<Text tag="h4" type="expressive-heading-01">Expressive heading 01</Text>
<Text tag="h3" type="expressive-heading-02">Expressive heading 02</Text>
<Text tag="h3" type="expressive-heading-03">Expressive heading 03</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="expressive-heading-04">Expressive heading 04</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="expressive-heading-05">Expressive heading 05</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="expressive-heading-06">Expressive heading 06</Text>
<Text tag="blockquote" type="quotation-01">Quotation 01</Text>
<Text tag="blockquote" type="quotation-02">Quotation 02</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="display-01">Display 01</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="display-02">Display 02</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="display-03">Display 03</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="display-04">Display 04</Text>
```

### Custom element

Set `tag` to render a different element. Type and color apply to whichever tag you choose.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="em" type="body-short-01">Inline emphasis</Text>
<Text tag="blockquote" type="quotation-01"
  >A quotation rendered as a blockquote.</Text
>
```

### Modifiers

Set modifier props alongside a type style.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Text type="body-long-01" weight="light">Light weight (300)</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" weight="regular">Regular weight (400)</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" weight="semibold">Semibold weight (600)</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" italic>Italic body text</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" family="mono">IBM Plex Mono</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" family="serif">IBM Plex Serif</Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" family="sans-condensed"
    >IBM Plex Sans Condensed</Text
  >
  <Text type="body-long-01" family="sans-hebrew">IBM Plex Sans Hebrew</Text>
  <Text tag="h2" type="productive-heading-04" balance maxWidth="20rem"
    >Balanced heading across multiple lines</Text
  >
</Stack>
```

Set `wrap` to `break-word` to break long words, or `nowrap` to keep text on one line.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
  <Text type="body-short-01" wrap="break-word"
    >supercalifragilisticexpialidocious@example.com</Text
  >
</Box>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
  <Text type="body-short-01" wrap="nowrap"
    >This line will not wrap to the next row.</Text
  >
</Box>
```

#### Max width and full width

Set `maxWidth` to any CSS length. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings accept units such as ch, rem, %, or px. Text fills its container by default. Width caps are opt-in -- neither maxWidth nor fullWidth applies unless you set one.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Text type="body-long-01" maxWidth="38ch">
    Character measure (`38ch`) scales with the font size and is useful for
    readable line length.
  </Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" maxWidth="20rem">
    Rem-based width (`20rem`) tracks the root font size.
  </Text>
  <Text type="body-long-01" maxWidth={480}>
    Pixel width (`480`) when you need a fixed cap.
  </Text>
</Stack>
```

Set `fullWidth` when the row should span its container (`width: 100%`). A block element already spans its parent; use it in flex or grid layouts where width must be explicit. Pair with maxWidth when the row is full width but the copy should stay capped. Use [Box](/components/Box) for the bordered container:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box border="subtle" padding={5} fullWidth>
  <Text type="body-long-01" fullWidth maxWidth="38ch">
    This paragraph fills the container row but stops at 38ch.
  </Text>
</Box>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box border="subtle" padding={5} fullWidth>
  <Text type="body-long-01" fullWidth>
    Without `maxWidth`, `fullWidth` stretches across the entire container.
  </Text>
</Box>
```

### Truncate

Set `lines` to truncate overflow while keeping the Carbon type style. See also [Truncate](/components/Truncate) for wrapping inline text, or the truncate action on native elements.

#### Single line

Set `lines` to `1` to truncate a single line with an ellipsis. Pair with `maxWidth` (or a constrained container) so there is a boundary to truncate against.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-short-01" maxWidth="16rem" lines={1}>
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System.
</Text>
```

Set `clamp` to `"front"` to truncate from the start instead of the end. `clamp` only takes effect when `lines` is `1`; multiline mode always clamps at the end.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-short-01" maxWidth="16rem" lines={1} clamp="front">
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System.
</Text>
```

#### Multiline

Values of `lines` above `1` use multiline mode (end clamp only).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-long-01" maxWidth="20rem" lines={3}>
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM. It is maintained by
  the open source community and is available on npm.
</Text>
```

Alternatively, wrap inline Text with the Truncate component:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Truncate lines={3}>
  <Box maxWidth="20rem">
    <Text tag="span" type="body-long-02">
      Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
      Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM. It is
      maintained by the open source community and is available on npm.
    </Text>
  </Box>
</Truncate>
```

### Typography inspiration

Combine type, color, and element choice as you would on an IBM product page: expressive type for editorial moments, productive type for application UI.

```svelte
<script>

<Stack gap={8}>

  >
  <Stack gap={5}>

    <Text type="body-long-02" color="primary" maxWidth="52ch"
```

### Utility classes

Apply Carbon type utilities directly when you do not need the component. Classes use the `bx--` prefix.

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bx--type-{token}` | Carbon type style. See [Type styles](#type-styles) for tokens |
| `bx--type-text-primary` | Primary text color |
| `bx--type-text-secondary` | Secondary text color |
| `bx--type-text-placeholder` | Placeholder text color |
| `bx--type-text-helper` | Helper text color |
| `bx--type-text-on-color` | Text on a colored background |
| `bx--type-text-inverse` | Text on an inverse surface |
| `bx--type-text-error` | Error text color |
| `bx--type-text-disabled` | Disabled text color |
| `bx--type-mono` | IBM Plex Mono |
| `bx--type-sans` | IBM Plex Sans |
| `bx--type-sans-condensed` | IBM Plex Sans Condensed |
| `bx--type-sans-hebrew` | IBM Plex Sans Hebrew |
| `bx--type-serif` | IBM Plex Serif |
| `bx--type-light` | Font weight 300 |
| `bx--type-regular` | Font weight 400 |
| `bx--type-semibold` | Font weight 600 |
| `bx--type-italic` | Italic |
| `bx--type-break-word` | Break long words |
| `bx--type-nowrap` | Keep text on one line |
| `bx--type-balance` | Balance line lengths |
| `bx--type-full-width` | Span the full container width (`width: 100%`) |

```svelte
<p class="bx--type-heading-02">Styled with bx--type-heading-02</p>
<p class="bx--type-body-long-01 bx--type-semibold">Semibold body text</p>
<p class="bx--type-body-long-01" style="max-width: 38ch">
  Constrained with inline max-width
</p>
```

### Component API

#### `Text` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"caption-01" \| "caption-02" \| "label-01" \| "label-02" \| "helper-text-01" \| "helper-text-02" \| "body-short-01" \| "body-short-02" \| "body-long-01" \| "body-long-02" \| "code-01" \| "code-02" \| "heading-01" \| "heading-02" \| "productive-heading-01" \| "productive-heading-02" \| "productive-heading-03" \| "productive-heading-04" \| "productive-heading-05" \| "productive-heading-06" \| "productive-heading-07" \| "expressive-paragraph-01" \| "expressive-heading-01" \| "expressive-heading-02" \| "expressive-heading-03" \| "expressive-heading-04" \| "expressive-heading-05" \| "expressive-heading-06" \| "quotation-01" \| "quotation-02" \| "display-01" \| "display-02" \| "display-03" \| "display-04"` | Set the Carbon type style. | `"body-long-01"` |
| `color` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "placeholder" \| "helper" \| "on-color" \| "inverse" \| "error" \| "disabled"` | Set the text color using a Carbon text token. | _undefined_ |
| `weight` | `"light" \| "regular" \| "semibold"` | Set the font weight. | _undefined_ |
| `italic` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render italic text | `false` |
| `family` | `"mono" \| "sans" \| "serif" \| "sans-condensed" \| "sans-hebrew"` | Set the font family. | _undefined_ |
| `wrap` | `"break-word" \| "nowrap"` | Set text wrapping behavior. | _undefined_ |
| `balance` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to balance line lengths across broken headings and short blocks | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Set the max width. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings accept any CSS length (e.g. `"38ch"`, `"20rem"`). | _undefined_ |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to span the full width of the container | `false` |
| `lines` | `number \| undefined` | Truncate text after this many lines. Values above `1` use multiline mode (end clamp only). | _undefined_ |
| `clamp` | `"end" \| "front"` | Specify `"end"` or `"front"`. `"front"` only works when `lines` is `1`. | `"end"` |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the tag name. | `"p"` |

#### `Text` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Text` $$restProps

`Text` spreads `$$restProps` to the `any` element.


## TextArea

### Basic

Create a basic textarea with a label and placeholder text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea labelText="App description" placeholder="Enter a description..." />
```

### Rows and columns

Control the visible size of the textarea.

#### Rows

Adjust visible rows with `rows`. The default is `4`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  rows={10}
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

#### Columns

Adjust visible columns with `cols`. Setting `cols` disables the default resize handle; override this with the `resize` style property.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  cols={40}
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

### Maximum character count

Specify the max character count with `maxCount`. A character counter appears to the right of the label. Use the native maxlength attribute instead if you prefer not to show a counter.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
  maxCount={100}
/>
```

### Helper text

Add helper text below the textarea to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="App description"
  helperText="A rich description helps us better recommend related products and services"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  hideLabel
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea labelText="" placeholder="Enter a description...">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">App description</strong>
</TextArea>
```

### Light

Enable the light variant with `light`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  light
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to embed the label inside the field. Fluid text areas work standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), which applies the variant automatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

#### Maximum character count

The character counter sits at the trailing edge of the field, opposite the embedded label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
  maxCount={100}
/>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="App description"
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
>

    App description
    <TooltipIcon

      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</TextArea>
```

#### Invalid

```svelte
  placeholder="Enter a description..."
/>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
  warn
  warnText="This description is shorter than recommended for product listings"
```

## TextInput

### Basic

Create a basic text input with a label and placeholder text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="User name" placeholder="Enter user name..." />
```

### Helper text

Add helper text below the input to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  labelText="User name"
  helperText="Your user name is associated with your email"
  placeholder="Enter user name..."
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput hideLabel labelText="User name" placeholder="Enter user name..." />
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="" placeholder="Enter user name...">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">User name</strong>
</TextInput>
```

### Maximum character count

Specify the max character count with `maxCount`. A character counter appears to the right of the label. Use the native maxlength attribute instead if you prefer not to show a counter.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  labelText="User name"
  placeholder="Enter user name..."
  maxCount={10}
/>
```

### Events

Respond to value changes.

#### Value change

Use `on:input` to listen for every keystroke, and `on:change` to listen for committed changes on blur. Both events dispatch the current value directly as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  labelText="User name"
  placeholder="Enter user name..."
  on:input={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // string | null
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // string | null
/>
```

#### Numeric values

Set the native `type` attribute to `"number"` to parse `value` as a number. The bound value--and the event detail dispatched by `on:input` and `on:change`--is `null` when the input is empty, otherwise a `number`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput type="number" labelText="Age" placeholder="Enter age..." />
```

### Light

Use the light variant for light-themed backgrounds with `light`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput light labelText="User name" placeholder="Enter user name..." />
```

### Fluid

Use the fluid variant with `fluid`, which embeds the label inside the field. Fluid text inputs can be used standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), where the fluid variant is applied automatically. The fluid variant cannot be combined with the inline variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput fluid labelText="User name" placeholder="Enter user name..." />
```

#### Maximum character count

The character counter sits at the trailing edge of the field, opposite the embedded label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  fluid
  labelText="User name"
  placeholder="Enter user name..."
  maxCount={10}
/>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<TextInput fluid labelText="User name" placeholder="Enter user name...">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    User name
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Your user name is associated with your email."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</TextInput>
```

#### Invalid

Fluid text inputs display the error message inside the field boundary. Long messages wrap to multiple lines.

```svelte

</script>

  invalid
  invalidText="User name is already taken. Please choose a different name that is not in use by another account on this system."
  labelText="User name"
  placeholder="Enter user name..."
/>
```

#### Warning

```svelte

  fluid
  warn
  warnText="Your user name is different from your log in ID."
  labelText="User name"
```

## Theme

### Setup

Theme supports five built-in themes and custom token overrides. Import `all.css` for dynamic theming, which uses [CSS variables](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Using_CSS_custom_properties).

```css
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css";
```

### Basic

Create a basic theme component that can be controlled programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Theme,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let theme = "g90";
</script>

<Theme bind:theme />

<RadioButtonGroup legendText="Carbon theme" bind:selected={theme}>
  {#each ["white", "g10", "g80", "g90", "g100"] as value}
    <RadioButton labelText={value} {value} />
  {/each}
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Persist locally

Set `persist` to `true` to save the theme in [localStorage](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/localStorage). Use `persistKey` for a custom storage key.

When persistence is enabled, theme changes sync across browser tabs that share the same `persistKey`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Theme,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let theme = "g90";
</script>

<Theme bind:theme persist persistKey="__carbon-theme" />

<RadioButtonGroup legendText="Carbon theme" bind:selected={theme}>
  {#each ["white", "g10", "g80", "g90", "g100"] as value}
    <RadioButton labelText={value} {value} />
  {/each}
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Custom theme

Override default Carbon theme tokens using the `tokens` prop.

`Theme` sets CSS custom properties as `--cds-{token}`. Not every token name maps directly to component styles. Components often use semantic tokens (like `interactive-01`) rather than component-specific ones.

For example, primary buttons use `interactive-01` for background, with separate hover and active tokens. Check component CSS or Carbon docs to see which tokens affect a given component.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    InlineNotification,
    Link,
    Stack,
    Tag,
    TextInput,
    Theme,
    Tile,
    Toggle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme
  theme="g90"
  tokens={{
    // Interactive elements
    "interactive-01": "#d02670", // Primary button background
    "hover-primary": "#ee5396", // Primary button hover
    "active-primary": "#9f1853", // Primary button active
    "interactive-02": "#6f6f6f", // Secondary button background
    "hover-secondary": "#5e5e5e", // Secondary button hover

    // Links
    "link-01": "#ff6eb3", // Link text color

    // Tags
    "tag-background-blue": "#4a1942", // Tag background
    "tag-color-blue": "#ffb3d9", // Tag text color

    // Form elements
    "field-01": "#2d2d2d", // Input field background
    "ui-01": "#2d2d2d", // Tile background
    focus: "#ff6eb3", // Focus indicator color

    // Text colors
    "text-01": "#ffffff", // Primary text
    "text-02": "#c6c6c6", // Secondary text

    // Notification colors
    "support-04": "#a855f7", // Info notification color
  }}
/>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <Button>Primary button</Button>
    <Button kind="secondary">Secondary button</Button>
  </div>

  <div>
    <Link href="#example">Themed link</Link>
  </div>

  <div><Tag type="blue">Themed tag</Tag></div>

  <TextInput labelText="Text input" placeholder="Enter text..." />

  <Checkbox labelText="Checkbox with themed focus" />

  <Toggle labelText="Toggle with themed colors" />

  <Tile><p>Tile with themed background</p></Tile>

  <InlineNotification
    kind="info"
    title="Info notification"
    subtitle="With themed colors"
    hideCloseButton
    lowContrast
  />
</Stack>
```

### Controls

Render a built-in control instead of managing `theme` yourself. Set `render` to `"toggle"`, `"select"`, or `"dropdown"`.

#### Toggle

Set `render` to `"toggle"` to display a toggle switch for switching between two themes. By default, it toggles between "white" and "g100" themes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme render="toggle" />
```

##### Custom

Customize themes, labels, and other toggle options with `toggle`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme
  render="toggle"
  toggle={{
    themes: ["g10", "g80"],
    labelA: "Enable dark mode",
    labelB: "Enable dark mode",
    hideLabel: true,
    size: "sm",
  }}
/>
```

#### Select

Set `render` to `"select"` to display a dropdown menu for selecting from all available themes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme render="select" />
```

##### Custom

Choose which themes to include, customize labels, and adjust other select options with `select`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme
  render="select"
  select={{
    themes: ["white", "g90", "g100"],
    labelText: "Select a theme",
    inline: true,
  }}
/>
```

#### Dropdown

Set `render` to `"dropdown"` to display a Dropdown component for selecting from all available themes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme render="dropdown" />
```

##### Custom

Choose which themes to include, customize labels, and adjust other dropdown options with `dropdown`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme
  render="dropdown"
  dropdown={{
    themes: ["white", "g90", "g100"],
    labelText: "Select a theme",
    type: "inline",
  }}
/>
```

### Events

Theme dispatches an `update` event whenever `theme` changes, whether from a built-in control or a bound value updated elsewhere in your app. The initial theme on mount does not dispatch `update`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme render="toggle" on:update={(e) => console.log(e.detail.theme)} />
```

### Slot

Use the default slot to access the current `theme` value with `let:theme`, without duplicating local state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Theme render="select" let:theme>
  <p>Current theme: {theme}</p>
</Theme>
```

### Exported themes constant

The `themes` constant exports all theme keys and labels for programmatic use.

Import `themes` from the Theme component file in a `script context="module"` block.

```html
<script context="module">
  import { themes } from "carbon-components-svelte/src/Theme/Theme.svelte";

  // themes = {
  //   white: "White",
  //   g10: "Gray 10",
  //   g80: "Gray 80",
  //   g90: "Gray 90",
  //   g100: "Gray 100"
  // }

  // Get all theme keys programmatically
  const themeKeys = Object.keys(themes); // ["white", "g10", "g80", "g90", "g100"]

  // Build custom theme selectors with correct labels
  Object.entries(themes).forEach(([key, label]) => {
    console.log(`${key}: ${label}`); // "white: White", etc.
  });
</script>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Theme` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` (Reactive) | `CarbonTheme` | Set the current Carbon theme. | `"white"` |
| `tokens` | `Tokens` | Customize a theme with your own tokens.<br />@see https://carbondesignsystem.com/elements/themes/overview/#customizing-a-theme | `{}` |
| `persist` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to persist the theme using window.localStorage | `false` |
| `persistKey` | `string` | Specify the local storage key | `"theme"` |
| `render` | `"toggle" \| "select" \| "dropdown"` | Render a toggle, select, or dropdown to control the theme. | _undefined_ |
| `toggle` | `import("../Toggle/Toggle.svelte").ToggleProps & { themes?: [labelA: CarbonTheme, labelB: CarbonTheme]; }` | Override the default toggle props. | `{<br />  themes: ["white", "g100"],<br />  labelA: "",<br />  labelB: "",<br />  labelText: "Dark mode",<br />  hideLabel: false,<br />}` |
| `select` | `import("../Select/Select.svelte").SelectProps<CarbonTheme> & { themes?: CarbonTheme[]; }` | Override the default select props. | `{<br />  themes: themeKeys,<br />  labelText: "Themes",<br />  hideLabel: false,<br />}` |
| `dropdown` | `Omit<import("../Dropdown/Dropdown.svelte").DropdownProps, "items" \| "selectedId"> & { themes?: CarbonTheme[]; }` | Override the default dropdown props. | `{<br />  themes: themeKeys,<br />  labelText: "Themes",<br />  hideLabel: false,<br />}` |

#### `Theme` typedefs

```ts
type CarbonTheme = "white" | "g10" | "g80" | "g90" | "g100";
```

#### `Theme` slots

| Slot      | Detail                   |
| --------- | ------------------------ |
| `default` | `{ theme: CarbonTheme }` |

#### `Theme` dispatched events

| Event       | Detail                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `on:update` | `{<br />  theme: CarbonTheme;<br />}` |


## Tile

### Basic

Create a basic tile container for your content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile>Content</Tile>
```

### Light

Use the light variant for light-themed backgrounds by setting `light` to `true`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile light>Content</Tile>
```

### Custom interaction

The tile forwards `on:click`, `on:mouseover`, `on:mouseenter`, and `on:mouseleave` for custom interactions. Unlike `ClickableTile`, a plain tile has no `tabindex` and doesn't respond to <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd>--use `ClickableTile` if you need built-in keyboard accessibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile on:click={() => console.log("clicked")}>Content</Tile>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Tile` props

| Prop    | Type      | Description                               | Default |
| ------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `light` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the light variant | `false` |

#### `Tile` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Tile` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Tile` $$restProps

`Tile` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## TimePicker

### Basic

Create a time picker with period (AM/PM) and timezone selectors.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Formatting

Customize input validation to match a different time notation.

#### 24-hour clock

The default `pattern` validates a 12-hour `h:mm` or `hh:mm` value. Override `pattern` (and update `helperText` or `placeholder` to match) to accept a 24-hour clock instead. A 24-hour field typically drops the AM/PM select.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker
  pattern="([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]"
  labelText="Cron job"
  placeholder="hh:mm"
  helperText="24-hour clock, e.g. 14:30"
  value="14:30"
>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

#### Seconds

Update `pattern` and increase `maxlength` together to accept a `hh:mm:ss` value. The default `maxlength` (5) only fits `hh:mm`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker
  pattern="(1[012]|[1-9]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]"
  maxlength={8}
  labelText="Cron job"
  placeholder="hh:mm:ss"
  value="2:15:30"
>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Events

Respond to edits on the time field and to period/timezone selection.

#### Change

`on:change` and `on:input` forward the native input events from the time field. Read the current value from `event.target.value`, or use `bind:value` for two-way binding.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker
  labelText="Cron job"
  placeholder="hh:mm"
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.target.value)}
>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

#### Period and timezone change

`TimePickerSelect` forwards `on:change` from its native select element the same way.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm" on:change={(e) => console.log(e.target.value)}>
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Select icon label

Set `iconDescription` on `TimePickerSelect` to change the chevron icon's ARIA label and native tooltip. It defaults to `"Open list of options"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect iconDescription="Choose AM or PM" value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect iconDescription="Choose timezone" value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Helper text

Add helper text to provide additional context or formatting instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker
  labelText="Cron job"
  placeholder="hh:mm"
  helperText="24-hour, e.g. 14:30"
>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker hideLabel labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Light

Enable the light variant with `light`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker light labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to embed labels inside each field cell. Fluid time pickers work standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), which applies the variant automatically.

Fluid time pickers fill their container using percentage-based columns (25% / 25% / 50% with two selects, 50% / 50% with one). Give the parent a defined width so those ratios resolve as intended.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker fluid labelText="Time" placeholder="hh:mm">
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am">
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Timezone" value="et">
      <SelectItem value="et" text="Eastern Time (ET)" />
      <SelectItem value="pt" text="Pacific Time (PT)" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

With a single period selector, the time input and select share equal width.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker fluid labelText="Time" placeholder="hh:mm">
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am">
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
    TooltipIcon,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker fluid labelText="Time" placeholder="hh:mm">
    <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
      Time
      <TooltipIcon
        tooltipText="Enter time in hh:mm format."
        icon={Information}
      />
    </svelte:fragment>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am">
      <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
        Clock
        <TooltipIcon tooltipText="Select AM or PM." icon={Information} />
      </svelte:fragment>
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Invalid

Fluid time pickers display the error message inside the field boundary. Long messages wrap to multiple lines.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker
    fluid
    invalid
    invalidText="A valid time is required. Enter the hour and minute in hh:mm format using a 12-hour clock, for example 09:30 or 2:15."
    labelText="Time"
    placeholder="hh:mm"
  >
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am">
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Timezone" value="et">
      <SelectItem value="et" text="Eastern Time (ET)" />
      <SelectItem value="pt" text="Pacific Time (PT)" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker
    fluid
    warn
    warnText="The selected time is outside business hours"
    labelText="Time"
    placeholder="hh:mm"
  >
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am">
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Timezone" value="et">
      <SelectItem value="et" text="Eastern Time (ET)" />
      <SelectItem value="pt" text="Pacific Time (PT)" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Disabled

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the time picker is disabled.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker
    fluid
    disabled
    invalid
    invalidText="A valid time is required"
    labelText="Time"
    placeholder="hh:mm"
  >
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" value="am" disabled>
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Timezone" value="et" disabled>
      <SelectItem value="et" text="Eastern Time (ET)" />
      <SelectItem value="pt" text="Pacific Time (PT)" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Read-only

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the time picker is read-only.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div style:width="350px">
  <TimePicker
    fluid
    readonly
    warn
    warnText="The selected time is outside business hours"
    labelText="Time"
    placeholder="hh:mm"
    value="10:30"
  >
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Clock" readonly value="am">
      <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
      <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
    <TimePickerSelect labelText="Timezone" readonly value="et">
      <SelectItem value="et" text="Eastern Time (ET)" />
      <SelectItem value="pt" text="Pacific Time (PT)" />
    </TimePickerSelect>
  </TimePicker>
</div>
```

#### Skeleton

Display a loading skeleton for the fluid time picker variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { FluidTimePickerSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<FluidTimePickerSkeleton />
```

Set `isOnlyTwo` to render only two elements.

```svelte
<script>
  import { FluidTimePickerSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<FluidTimePickerSkeleton isOnlyTwo />
```

### Sizes

The default input height is medium. Set `size` to choose another variant.

#### Extra-large

Use the extra-large size for more prominent time pickers by setting `size` to `"xl"`.

```svelte

    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

<TimePicker size="xl" labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
  <TimePickerSelect value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

#### Small

Use the small size for more compact time pickers by setting `size` to `"sm"`.

```svelte

  import {
    SelectItem,

<TimePicker size="sm" labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm">
```

#### Disabled

Disable the time picker with `disabled`.

```svelte

    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  <TimePickerSelect value="pm" disabled>

    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

#### Read-only

Set `readonly` to display a value while preventing edits. Unlike disabled, the input stays focusable and its value is submitted with the form. Period and timezone selectors accept the same flag so all fields match.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    SelectItem,
    TimePicker,
    TimePickerSelect,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TimePicker readonly labelText="Cron job" placeholder="hh:mm" value="10:30">
  <TimePickerSelect readonly value="pm">
    <SelectItem value="am" text="AM" />
    <SelectItem value="pm" text="PM" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
  <TimePickerSelect readonly value="pdt">
    <SelectItem value="pdt" text="PDT" />
    <SelectItem value="gmt" text="GMT" />
  </TimePickerSelect>
</TimePicker>
```

### Component API

#### `TimePicker` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string` | Specify the input value. | `""` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the input. | _undefined_ |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Specify the input placeholder text | `"hh:mm"` |
| `pattern` | `string` | Specify the `pattern` attribute for the input element | `"(1[012]\|[1-9]):[0-5][0-9](\\s)?"` |
| `maxlength` | `number` | Specify the `maxlength` input attribute | `5` |
| `light` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the light variant | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the input | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark the input as read-only | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input element | `uniqueId()` |
| `name` | `string` | Specify a name attribute for the input. | _undefined_ |
| `fluid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the fluid variant.<br />Inherited from the parent `FluidForm` context,<br />so it does not need to be set when used inside `FluidForm`. | `false` |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Value` | Specify the option value. | `""` |
| `text` | `string` | Specify the option text.<br />If not specified, the value will be used as the text. | _undefined_ |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the option | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the option | `false` |
| `class` | `string` | Specify the class of the `option` element. | _undefined_ |
| `style` | `string` | Specify the style of the `option` element. | _undefined_ |

#### `FluidTimePickerSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isOnlyTwo` | `boolean` | Set to `true` if there are only two time picker elements | `false` |

#### `FluidTimePickerSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `FluidTimePickerSkeleton` $$restProps

`FluidTimePickerSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ToastNotification

### Basic

Display a basic error notification with title, subtitle, and timestamp by default. See [detailed usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/notification/usage) and the related [InlineNotification](InlineNotification). For an imperative API to manage multiple toasts with automatic queue management, see [NotificationQueue](NotificationQueue).

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification
  title="Error"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
/>
```

### Reusable

Control notification visibility by binding to `open` to show, hide, and reuse the same component with different messages. Open defaults to true.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Stack,
    ToastNotification,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let kind = "error";
  let title = "Error";
  let subtitle = "An internal server error occurred.";
  let caption = new Date().toLocaleString();

  function showError() {
    kind = "error";
    title = "Error";
    subtitle = "An internal server error occurred.";
    caption = new Date().toLocaleString();
    open = true;
  }

  function showSuccess() {
    kind = "success";
    title = "Success";
    subtitle = "Your settings have been saved.";
    caption = new Date().toLocaleString();
    open = true;
  }

  function showWarning() {
    kind = "warning";
    title = "Warning";
    subtitle = "Please review your changes before continuing.";
    caption = new Date().toLocaleString();
    open = true;
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button on:click={showSuccess}>Show success</Button>
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={showWarning}>Show warning</Button>
    <Button kind="danger-ghost" on:click={showError}>Show error</Button>
  </ButtonSet>

  <ToastNotification bind:open {kind} {title} {subtitle} {caption} />
</Stack>
```

### Autoclose

Automatically close the notification after a specified duration (in milliseconds) with `timeout`. Set `pauseOnHover` to pause the timeout while the pointer is over the toast so users can finish reading (opt-in).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { fade } from "svelte/transition";

  let timeout = undefined;
  $: showNotification = timeout !== undefined;
</script>

<Button
  disabled={showNotification}
  on:click={() => {
    timeout = 3_000; // 3 seconds
  }}
>
  Show notification
</Button>

{#if showNotification}
  <div transition:fade>
    <ToastNotification
      {timeout}
      kind="success"
      title="Success"
      subtitle="This notification will autoclose in {timeout.toLocaleString()} ms."
      caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
      on:close={(e) => {
        timeout = undefined;
        console.log(e.detail.timeout); // true if closed via timeout
      }}
    />
  </div>
{/if}
```

### Full width

Span the full container width with `fullWidth`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification
  fullWidth
  title="Error"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
/>
```

### Title, subtitle, caption

The subtitle and caption are optional, and all three can be customized with slots.

#### Optional

Subtitle and caption only render when provided.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification subtitle="An internal server error occurred." />
<ToastNotification
  title="Error"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
/>
<ToastNotification
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
/>
<ToastNotification title="Success" caption={new Date().toLocaleString()} />
```

#### Custom (slots)

Customize the notification content using slots for more flexibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification>
  <strong slot="titleChildren">Error: </strong>
  <strong slot="subtitleChildren">An internal server error occurred.</strong>
  <strong slot="captionChildren">{new Date().toLocaleString()}</strong>
</ToastNotification>
```

### Close button

Hide the close button or customize its behavior and label.

#### Hidden

Create a persistent notification by hiding the close button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification
  hideCloseButton
  kind="warning"
  title="Scheduled maintenance"
  subtitle="Maintenance will last 2-4 hours."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
/>
```

#### Translated label

Translate the close button label via `closeButtonDescription`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification
  title="错误"
  subtitle="发生内部服务器错误"
  closeButtonDescription="关闭通知"
/>
```

#### Prevent default

Prevent the default close behavior using `e.preventDefault()` in the `on:close` event handler.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToastNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToastNotification
  title="Error"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
  on:close={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // custom close logic (e.g., transitions)
  }}
/>

## ARIA role Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container to control
how screen readers announce it. Defaults to `"alert"` for interruptive
announcements. Use `"status"` for polite live-region updates, or `"log"` for a
running log of messages.

<ToastNotification
  role="status"
  kind="success"
  title="Success"
  subtitle="Your settings have been saved."
  caption={new Date().toLocaleString()}
/>
```

### Component API

#### `ToastNotification` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the notification, `false` to hide it. | `true` |
| `kind` | `"error" \| "info" \| "info-square" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "warning-alt"` | Specify the kind of notification. | `"error"` |
| `lowContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant | `false` |
| `timeout` | `number` | Set the timeout duration (ms) to hide the notification after opening it | `0` |
| `pauseOnHover` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to pause the auto-dismiss timeout while the pointer is over the notification. | `false` |
| `role` | `"alert" \| "log" \| "status"` | Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container. | `"alert"` |
| `title` | `string` | Specify the title text | `""` |
| `subtitle` | `string` | Specify the subtitle text | `""` |
| `caption` | `string` | Specify the caption text | `""` |
| `closeButtonDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the close button | `"Close notification"` |
| `hideCloseButton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the close button | `false` |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the notification to span<br />the full width of its containing element. | `false` |

#### `ToastNotification` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `captionChildren`  | `Record<string, never>` |
| `subtitleChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `titleChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToastNotification` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ToastNotification` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail                              |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  timeout: boolean;<br />}` |

#### `ToastNotification` $$restProps

`ToastNotification` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Toggle

### Basic

Display a basic toggle in its untoggled state by default.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications" />
```

### Toggled

Display the toggle in its on state with `toggled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications" toggled />
```

### Labels

Customize or hide the toggle labels.

#### Hidden

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications" hideLabel />
```

#### Custom

Customize toggle labels with `labelA` and `labelB`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications" labelA="No" labelB="Yes" />
```

#### Slottable

Use slots to customize the toggle labels with additional styling or content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications">
  <span slot="labelA" style="color: red">No</span>
  <span slot="labelB" style="color: green">Yes</span>
</Toggle>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content instead of `labelText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Fallback label">
  <span slot="labelChildren">
    Push notifications <strong>(recommended)</strong>
  </span>
</Toggle>
```

### States

Reflect interaction states.

#### Disabled

Disable interaction with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Push notifications" disabled />
```

#### Read-only

Display a non-editable value with `readonly`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle readonly toggled labelText="Push notifications (on)" />
```

### Small

Use the small size variant by setting `size` to `"sm"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle size="sm" labelText="Push notifications" />
```

### Reactive

Use two-way binding with `bind:toggled` to track and update the toggle state programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toggle labelText="Push notifications" bind:toggled />
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (toggled = !toggled)}>
      Toggle
      {toggled ? "off" : "on"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Events

Use `on:toggle` to listen for state changes. The event dispatches `{ toggled: boolean }` as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle, ToggleSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle
  labelText="Push notifications"
  on:toggle={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
/>

## Skeleton Display a loading state using the skeleton component.

<ToggleSkeleton />

### Small Use the small size variant for the skeleton component.

<ToggleSkeleton size="sm" />
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toggled` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to toggle the checkbox input. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |

| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input element | `uniqueId()` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |

| `on:mouseover`  |
