## Toggletip

### Basic

Unlike a tooltip, a toggletip opens and closes on click. Click the button to toggle the content. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> or click outside to close it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  Custom toggletip content with a longer description that wraps onto multiple
  lines.
</Toggletip>
```

### Reactive example

Control the toggletip state programmatically by binding to `open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12} align="start">
  <Toggletip bind:open labelText="Resource list" align="start">
    Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.
  </Toggletip>
  <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
    {open ? "Close toggletip" : "Open toggletip"}
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Custom labels

Customize the toggletip's visible label and the button's accessible name.

#### Label prop

Render an inline label beside the button using the `labelText` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip labelText="Setting">
  This setting controls how items are displayed.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Label slot

Alternatively, use the `"labelText"` slot for custom markup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  <span slot="labelText"><strong>Setting</strong></span>
  This setting controls how items are displayed.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Accessible label

Set the button's ARIA label with `iconDescription`. It defaults to `"Show information"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip iconDescription="Additional information">
  The button has a custom ARIA label.
</Toggletip>
```

### Actions

Use `ToggletipFooter` to render one or two actions at the base of the content.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Toggletip,
    ToggletipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  Custom toggletip content with actions.
  <ToggletipFooter>
    <Link href="#">Link action</Link>
    <Button size="small">Button</Button>
  </ToggletipFooter>
</Toggletip>
```

### Custom icon

#### Component

Pass an icon component to the `icon` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip icon={Add} iconDescription="Add">
  The button renders a custom icon.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Slot

Alternatively, use the `"icon"` slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip iconDescription="Add">
  <Add slot="icon" />
  The button renders a custom icon.
</Toggletip>
```

### Placement

Position the content with `direction` (`"top"`, `"right"`, `"bottom"`, `"left"`) and `align` (`"start"`, `"center"`, `"end"`). The defaults are `direction="bottom"` and `align="center"`.

#### Directions

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip direction="top">top</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="right">right</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom">bottom</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="left">left</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

#### Alignment

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="start">start</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="center">center</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="end">end</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

### Portal

Set `portalTooltip` to render the content in a portal so it is not clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box padding={5} border="subtle" maxWidth="8rem" style="overflow: hidden;">
  <Toggletip portalTooltip>
    This content escapes the clipping container via a portal.
  </Toggletip>
</Box>
```

#### Directions

Portalled content supports every `direction`. The portal flips to the opposite side when there is not enough space.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="top">top</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="right">right</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom">bottom</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="left">left</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

#### Alignment

Portalled content supports every `align` value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="start">start</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="center">center</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="end">end</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

### Inside a modal

When a toggletip is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), the content is portalled by default so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. There is no need to set `portalTooltip`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Modal,
    Portal,
    Stack,
    Toggletip,
    ToggletipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    passiveModal
    modalHeading="Toggletip in modal"
    on:close={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" align="center" gap={3}>
      Resource list
      <Toggletip>
        Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.
        <ToggletipFooter>
          <Link href="#">Learn more</Link>
          <Button size="small">Manage</Button>
        </ToggletipFooter>
      </Toggletip>
    </Stack>
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Toggletip` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the toggletip. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. | `null` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the content relative to the button. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the direction of the content relative to the button. | `"bottom"` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the toggletip button.<br />Defaults to `<Information />`. | `Information` |
| `iconName` | `string` | Specify the icon name attribute | `""` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the toggletip button | `"Show information"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Set the toggletip label text.<br />Alternatively, use the "labelText" slot. | `""` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to render the content in a portal,<br />preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers.<br />By default, the content is portalled when inside a `Modal`. | _undefined_ |

#### `Toggletip` slots

| Slot        | Detail                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`   | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon`      | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelText` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Toggletip` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:close` | `null` |
| `on:open`  | `null` |

#### `Toggletip` $$restProps

`Toggletip` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span` element.

#### `ToggletipFooter` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToggletipFooter` $$restProps

`ToggletipFooter` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Toolbar

### Basic

Create a basic toolbar with content inside toolbar content. **Toolbar** can be used independently of DataTable--it provides its own context for child components like **ToolbarMenu**, **ToolbarSearch**, and **ToolbarBatchActions**, so every example on this page works standalone. To use a toolbar with a data table instead, see [DataTable's Toolbar section](/components/DataTable#toolbar).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button>Primary action</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Accessible label

Set `ariaLabel` to override the toolbar's accessible name. The default, `"data table toolbar"`, is inherited from Toolbar's original use inside DataTable--override it for standalone toolbars so assistive technology announces something more meaningful.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar ariaLabel="Product actions">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Sizes

The default toolbar height is medium. Set `size` to choose another variant.

#### Small

Set `size="sm"` for a compact toolbar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar size="sm">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Extra-small

Set `size="xs"` for an extra-small toolbar, intended to pair with a compact data table.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar size="xs">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Search

Add search functionality using toolbar search.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Persistent

Set `persistent` on toolbar search to keep it always expanded.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch persistent placeholder="Search..." />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to disable the search field.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch disabled placeholder="Search..." />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Reactive

Bind to `value` for reactive updates. `expanded` is also bindable, so you can read or programmatically set whether the search field is open.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = "";
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch bind:value placeholder="Search..." />
      <Button size="small">Create</Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <div>
      <ButtonSet>
        <Button
          size="small"
          disabled={value === "products"}
          on:click={() => (value = "products")}
        >
          Set value
        </Button>
        <Button
          kind="ghost"
          size="small"
          disabled={value.length === 0}
          on:click={() => (value = "")}
        >
          Clear value
        </Button>
      </ButtonSet>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Search value:</strong>
      {value}
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Clear programmatically

Use `bind:this` to obtain a ToolbarSearch reference and call `clear()` to reset the value.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toolbarSearch;
  let value = "";
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch
        bind:this={toolbarSearch}
        bind:value
        persistent
        placeholder="Search..."
      />
      <Button
        kind="ghost"
        size="small"
        disabled={value.length === 0}
        on:click={() => toolbarSearch.clear()}
      >
        Clear search
      </Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <div>
    <strong>Search value:</strong>
    {value}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Clear event

Listen for `on:clear` to know when the user clears the field--by clicking the built-in clear icon or pressing <kbd>Escape</kbd> while focused. This is distinct from calling the exported `clear()` method yourself, which updates `value` and `expanded` directly without dispatching the event.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarMenu,
    ToolbarMenuItem,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Filter from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Filter.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch
      persistent
      placeholder="Search..."
      on:clear={() => console.log("cleared")}
    />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

## Menu Add an overflow menu using toolbar menu and toolbar menu item.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
        >API documentation</ToolbarMenuItem
      >
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Settings</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Divider and danger item Use `hasDivider` to add a separator and `danger` for
destructive actions.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
        >API documentation</ToolbarMenuItem
      >
      <ToolbarMenuItem hasDivider danger>Stop all</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Primary focus Set `primaryFocus` on a menu item to focus it when opening the
dropdown.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
        >API documentation</ToolbarMenuItem
      >
      <ToolbarMenuItem primaryFocus hasDivider danger>Stop all</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Disabled item Set `disabled` on a menu item to prevent it from being
selected.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem disabled>Restart selected</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Custom icon **ToolbarMenu** extends
[OverflowMenu](/components/OverflowMenu), inheriting props such as `icon`. The
default icon is a settings gear--pass a different icon component to change it.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarMenu icon={Filter}>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Filter by category</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem>Filter by price</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

## Batch actions Toolbar batch actions display batch actions when items are
selected. Although intended for use with [DataTable](/components/DataTable),
batch actions can be used standalone when `selectedIds` is provided. That prop
is not required when used with a data table. ### Basic usage

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Manually controlling visibility Set `active` to `true` or `false` to
override the automatic visibility based on `selectedIds`. This is useful when
the batch action bar should be driven by application state instead of a
selection count. Here, the bar is forced open even though no items are selected.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions active>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Custom cancel label Override the Cancel button's text using the `cancel`
slot.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
    <svelte:fragment slot="cancel">Discard</svelte:fragment>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Total selected label Override the "N items selected" text with
`formatTotalSelected`.

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions
    selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}
    formatTotalSelected={(total) =>
      `${total} item${total === 1 ? "" : "s"} chosen`}
  >
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>

### Standalone with dynamic selection In standalone usage there's no `DataTable`
context to reset the selection automatically, so listen for `on:cancel` and
clear your own selection state in the handler.
```

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let items = [
    { id: 1, name: "Item 1", checked: false },
    { id: 2, name: "Item 2", checked: false },
    { id: 3, name: "Item 3", checked: false },
  ];
  let nextId = items.length + 1;

  $: selectedIds = items.filter((item) => item.checked).map((item) => item.id);
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarBatchActions
      {selectedIds}
      on:cancel={() => {
        items = items.map((item) => ({ ...item, checked: false }));
      }}
    >
      <Button
        kind="danger"
        icon={TrashCan}
        on:click={() => {
          items = items.filter((item) => !item.checked);
        }}
      >
        Delete
      </Button>
    </ToolbarBatchActions>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <Button
        icon={Add}
        size="small"
        on:click={() => {
          items = [
            ...items,
            { id: nextId, name: `Item ${nextId}`, checked: false },
          ];
          nextId++;
        }}
      >
        Add item
      </Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <Stack>
    {#each items as item (item.id)}
      <Checkbox labelText={item.name} bind:checked={item.checked} />
    {/each}
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Composition

#### Complete toolbar

Combine search, menu, and buttons for a full-featured toolbar.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarMenu,
    ToolbarMenuItem,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch />
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem primaryFocus>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/loadbalancer-service">
        API documentation
      </ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem hasDivider danger>Stop all</ToolbarMenuItem>
    </ToolbarMenu>
    <Button>Create balancer</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### With multiple actions

Stack multiple action buttons in the toolbar.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch persistent />
    <Button kind="secondary" size="small">Export</Button>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Component API

#### `Toolbar` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "default"` | Specify the toolbar size.<br />If unset, the size is inherited from the parent `DataTable`<br />("xs" for "compact", "sm" for "short", "default" otherwise). | _undefined_ |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the toolbar. | `"data table toolbar"` |

#### `Toolbar` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Toolbar` $$restProps

`Toolbar` spreads `$$restProps` to the `section` element.

#### `ToolbarContent` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarSearch` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `number \| string` | Specify the value of the search input. | `""` |
| `expanded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to expand the search bar. | `false` |
| `filteredRowIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Row["id"]>` | The filtered row ids. | `[]` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `persistent` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to keep the search bar expanded | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the search bar | `false` |
| `shouldFilterRows` | `boolean \| ((row: Row, value: number \| string) => boolean)` | Set to `true` to filter table rows using the search value.<br /><br />If `true`, the default search excludes `id`, `cells` fields and<br />only does a basic comparison on string and number type cell values.<br /><br />To implement your own client-side filtering, pass a function<br />that accepts a row and value and returns a boolean. | `false` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Specify the tabindex | `"0"` |
| `clear` | `() => void` | Programmatically clear the search input.<br />Resets `value` and collapses the search bar (unless `persistent`). | _undefined_ |

#### `ToolbarSearch` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:blur`    |
| `on:change`  |
| `on:clear`   |
| `on:focus`   |
| `on:input`   |
| `on:keydown` |
| `on:keyup`   |
| `on:paste`   |

#### `ToolbarSearch` $$restProps

`ToolbarSearch` spreads `$$restProps` to the `input` element.

#### `ToolbarMenu` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarMenu` $$restProps

`ToolbarMenu` spreads `$$restProps` to the `OverflowMenu` component.

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:click`   |
| `on:keydown` |

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` $$restProps

`ToolbarMenuItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `OverflowMenuItem` component.

#### `ToolbarBatchActions` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatTotalSelected` | `(totalSelected: number) => string` | Override the total items selected text. | `(totalSelected) => `${totalSelected} item${totalSelected === 1 ? "" : "s"} selected`` |
| `active` | `undefined \| boolean` | Use a boolean to show or hide the toolbar. | _undefined_ |
| `selectedIds` | `ReadonlyArray<Id>` | Specify the selected IDs for standalone usage.<br />This is unnecessary if using this component with `DataTable`. | `[]` |

| Slot      | Detail                  |

| ----------- | ------ |

#### `ToolbarBatchActions` $$restProps

`ToolbarBatchActions` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Tooltip

### Basic

Display a tooltip triggered by the default information icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom labels

Customize the tooltip's visible trigger text and the icon button's accessible name.

#### Trigger text

Use custom trigger text instead of the default icon with `triggerText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Trigger text slot

Alternatively, use the `"triggerText"` slot for custom markup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip>
  <span slot="triggerText"><strong>Resource list</strong></span>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Accessible label

Set the button's ARIA label with `iconDescription`. It defaults to `"Show information"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip iconDescription="Additional information">
  <p>The button has a custom ARIA label.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Reactive example

Control the tooltip state programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12}>
  <Tooltip bind:open triggerText="Resource list" align="start">
    <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  </Tooltip>
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
      {open ? "Close tooltip" : "Open tooltip"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Dispatched events

The component dispatches `open` and `close` events.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let events = [];
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <Tooltip
    triggerText="Resource list"
    on:open={() => (events = [...events, "open"])}
    on:close={() => (events = [...events, "close"])}
  >
    <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  </Tooltip>
  <p>Dispatched events: {events.join(", ")}</p>
</Stack>
```

### Placement

Position the tooltip with direction and alignment.

#### Directions

Position the tooltip with `direction`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"><p>Right</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
```

#### Alignment

Align the tooltip content with `align`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Start" align="start"><p>Start</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="End" align="end"><p>End</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Center" align="center"><p>Center</p></Tooltip>
```

### Interactive

Add interactive elements like links and buttons using the tooltip footer.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Tooltip,
    TooltipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  <TooltipFooter selectorPrimaryFocus="#d">
    <Link href="/">Learn more</Link>
    <Button id="d" size="small">Manage</Button>
  </TooltipFooter>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom icon

Customize or hide the default trigger icon.

#### Component

Use a custom icon component with `icon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Catalog from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Catalog.svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list" icon={Catalog}>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Slot

Customize the icon using the `icon` slot for more flexibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <div
    slot="icon"
    style="width: 1rem; height: 1rem; outline: 1px solid red;"
  ></div>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Hidden icon

Hide the trigger icon while keeping tooltip behavior with `hideIcon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip hideIcon triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom delay

Customize the enter and leave delay with `enterDelayMs` and `leaveDelayMs`. Defaults are 100ms and 300ms.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Slow open" enterDelayMs={500} leaveDelayMs={200}>
  <p>This tooltip has a 500ms enter delay and a 200ms leave delay.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Portal

Set `portalTooltip` to render the tooltip in a portal so it is not clipped by overflow containers. This is enabled automatically inside a Modal.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Portalled">
  <p>This tooltip is rendered in a portal.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Hidden icon

Portal tooltips also work with a hidden trigger icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip hideIcon triggerText="Portalled (hidden icon)">
  <p>This tooltip is rendered in a portal without the icon.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Directions

Position portalled tooltips in different directions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"
  ><p>Right</p></Tooltip
>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"
  ><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip
>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
```

### Inside a modal

When a tooltip is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), it is automatically portalled so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. No need to set `portalTooltip` in this case.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, Portal, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    size="sm"
    modalHeading="Tooltip in modal"
    primaryButtonText="Done"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <Tooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"><p>Right</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Tooltip` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the tooltip. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the trigger text HTML element. | `null` |
| `refTooltip` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the tooltip HTML element. | `null` |
| `refIcon` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the icon HTML element. | `null` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the button. | `"bottom"` |
| `hideIcon` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the tooltip icon. | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the tooltip button.<br />Defaults to `<Information />`. | `Information` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the tooltip button | `"Show information"` |
| `iconName` | `string` | Specify the icon name attribute | `""` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Set the button tabindex | `"0"` |
| `tooltipId` | `string` | Set an id for the tooltip. | `uniqueId()` |
| `triggerId` | `string` | Set an id for the tooltip button. | `uniqueId()` |
| `triggerText` | `string` | Set the tooltip button text | `""` |
| `enterDelayMs` | `number` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip. | `100` |
| `leaveDelayMs` | `number` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip. | `300` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to render the tooltip in a portal,<br />preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers.<br />By default, the tooltip is portalled when inside a `Modal`. | _undefined_ |

#### `Tooltip` slots

| Slot          | Detail                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`     | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon`        | `Record<string, never>` |
| `triggerText` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Tooltip` forwarded events

| Event          |
| -------------- |
| `on:click`     |
| `on:mousedown` |

#### `Tooltip` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:close` | `null` |
| `on:open`  | `null` |

#### `Tooltip` $$restProps

`Tooltip` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `TooltipFooter` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectorPrimaryFocus` | `string` | Specify a selector to be focused inside the footer when opening the tooltip | `"a[href], button:not([disabled])"` |

#### `TooltipFooter` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |


## TooltipDefinition

### Basic

Display a basic definition tooltip with the default bottom-center alignment.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
>
  Armonk
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Placement

Position the tooltip with direction and alignment.

#### Directions

By default, the tooltip is positioned to the bottom.

Position the tooltip with `direction`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition direction="top" tooltipText="Top">Top</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition direction="bottom" tooltipText="Bottom">
  Bottom
</TooltipDefinition>
```

#### Alignment

By default, the tooltip is aligned to the center.

Align the tooltip content with `align`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition align="start" tooltipText="Start">Start</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition align="center" tooltipText="Center">
  Center
</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition align="end" tooltipText="End">End</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Open behavior

Control how and when the tooltip opens.

#### Click to open

Open the tooltip on click instead of hover with `clickToOpen`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  clickToOpen
  tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
>
  Armonk
</TooltipDefinition>
```

#### Open by default

Open the tooltip by default with `open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  open
  tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
>
  Armonk
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Reactive example

Control tooltip state programmatically with `bind:open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12}>
  <div>
    <TooltipDefinition
      align="start"
      bind:open
      tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
    >
      Armonk
    </TooltipDefinition>
  </div>
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
      {open ? "Close tooltip" : "Open tooltip"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Dispatched events

The component dispatches `open` and `close` events.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let events = [];
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  align="start"
  tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
  on:open={() => (events = [...events, "open"])}
  on:close={() => (events = [...events, "close"])}
>
  Dispatched events: {events.join(", ")}
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Custom delay

Customize hover delays with `enterDelayMs` and `leaveDelayMs`. Defaults are 100ms and 300ms.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  tooltipText="Slow to appear"
  enterDelayMs={500}
  leaveDelayMs={500}
>
  Armonk
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Custom tooltip slot

Use the `tooltip` slot to customize tooltip content with additional styling or structure.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition>
  Armonk
  <span slot="tooltip" style="color: red">
    IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York.
  </span>
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Portal

Set `portalTooltip` to render the tooltip in a portal so it is not clipped by overflow containers. This is enabled automatically inside a Modal. Alignment matches the non-portal path.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  portalTooltip
  tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
>
  Armonk
</TooltipDefinition>
```

#### Directions

Definition tooltips support top and bottom directions only. With portalling, direction behaves the same as the default CSS path.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition portalTooltip direction="top" tooltipText="Top">
  Top
</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition portalTooltip direction="bottom" tooltipText="Bottom">
  Bottom
</TooltipDefinition>
```

#### Alignment

Portalled tooltips use the same alignment options as the default path: horizontal placement along the anchor for top and bottom directions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipDefinition portalTooltip align="start" tooltipText="Start">
  Start
</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition portalTooltip align="center" tooltipText="Center">
  Center
</TooltipDefinition>
<TooltipDefinition portalTooltip align="end" tooltipText="End">
  End
</TooltipDefinition>
```

### Inside a modal

When a tooltip definition is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), it is automatically portalled so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. Set `portalTooltip` to override this behavior.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Modal,
    Portal,
    TooltipDefinition,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    size="sm"
    modalHeading="TooltipDefinition in modal"
    primaryButtonText="Done"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <TooltipDefinition
      direction="top"
      tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
    >
      Armonk (top)
    </TooltipDefinition>
    <TooltipDefinition
      direction="bottom"
      tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
    >
      Armonk (bottom)
    </TooltipDefinition>
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

---

### Component API

#### `TooltipDefinition` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the tooltip. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. | `null` |
| `tooltipText` | `string` | Specify the tooltip text | `""` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the icon. | `"bottom"` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the tooltip div element | `uniqueId()` |
| `clickToOpen` | `boolean` | By default, the tooltip is opened on hover or focus.<br />Set to `true` to open the tooltip on click/focus instead of on hover.<br />Unhovering or blurring the tooltip will close it. | `false` |
| `enterDelayMs` | `number` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip. | `100` |
| `leaveDelayMs` | `number` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip. | `300` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to render the tooltip in a portal,<br />preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers.<br />By default, the tooltip is portalled when inside a `Modal`. | _undefined_ |

#### `TooltipDefinition` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `tooltip` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `TooltipDefinition` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `TooltipDefinition` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:close` | `null` |
| `on:open`  | `null` |

#### `TooltipDefinition` $$restProps

`TooltipDefinition` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span` element.


## TooltipIcon

### Basic

Display a tooltip with the default bottom-center alignment.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon
  tooltipText="Carbon is an open source design system by IBM."
  icon={Carbon}
/>
```

### Reactive example

Control tooltip state programmatically with `bind:open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12}>
  <div>
    <TooltipIcon
      bind:open
      tooltipText="Carbon is an open source design system by IBM."
      icon={Carbon}
      align="start"
    />
  </div>
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
      {open ? "Close tooltip" : "Open tooltip"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Dispatched events

The component dispatches `open` and `close` events.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";

  let events = [];
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <TooltipIcon
    tooltipText="Carbon is an open source design system by IBM."
    icon={Carbon}
    on:open={() => (events = [...events, "open"])}
    on:close={() => (events = [...events, "close"])}
  />
  <p>Dispatched events: {events.join(", ")}</p>
</Stack>
```

### Sizes

Set icon size with `size`. Carbon icons use a 16/20/24/32 scale, but any pixel value works.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon tooltipText="16px" icon={Carbon} size={16} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="20px" icon={Carbon} size={20} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="24px" icon={Carbon} size={24} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="32px" icon={Carbon} size={32} />
```

### Placement

Position the tooltip with direction and alignment.

#### Directions

By default, the tooltip is positioned to the bottom.

Position the tooltip with `direction`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Filter from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Filter.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Top" direction="top" icon={Filter} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Right" direction="right" icon={Filter} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Bottom" direction="bottom" icon={Filter} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Left" direction="left" icon={Filter} />
```

#### Alignment

By default, the tooltip is aligned to the center.

Align the tooltip content with `align`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Filter from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Filter.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Start" align="start" icon={Filter} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Center" align="center" icon={Filter} />
<TooltipIcon tooltipText="End" align="end" icon={Filter} />
```

### Custom tooltip text

Use the `tooltipText` slot to customize the tooltip content with additional styling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon icon={Carbon}>
  <span slot="tooltipText" style="color: red"
    >Carbon is an open source design system by IBM.</span
  >
</TooltipIcon>
```

### Custom icon

Use the default slot to fully customize the trigger content, replacing what the `icon` prop would otherwise render.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon tooltipText="Custom icon content">
  <div style="width: 1rem; height: 1rem; outline: 1px solid red;"></div>
</TooltipIcon>
```

### Custom delay

Customize hover delays with `enterDelayMs` and `leaveDelayMs`. Defaults are 100ms and 300ms.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon
  tooltipText="Slow to appear"
  icon={Carbon}
  enterDelayMs={500}
  leaveDelayMs={500}
/>
```

### Disabled

Prevent interaction with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon
  disabled
  tooltipText="Carbon is an open source design system by IBM."
  icon={Carbon}
/>
```

### Portal

Set `portalTooltip` to render the tooltip in a portal so it is not clipped by overflow containers. This is enabled automatically inside a Modal. Direction and alignment match the non-portal path.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  tooltipText="Carbon is an open source design system by IBM."
  icon={Carbon}
/>
```

#### Directions

Icon tooltips support top, right, bottom, and left. With portalling, direction behaves the same as the default CSS path.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon portalTooltip direction="top" tooltipText="Top" icon={Carbon} />
<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  direction="right"
  tooltipText="Right"
  icon={Carbon}
/>
<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  direction="bottom"
  tooltipText="Bottom"
  icon={Carbon}
/>
<TooltipIcon portalTooltip direction="left" tooltipText="Left" icon={Carbon} />
```

#### Alignment

Portalled tooltips use the same alignment options as the default path: horizontal placement for top and bottom, vertical placement for left and right.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Carbon from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Carbon.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  direction="bottom"
  align="start"
  tooltipText="Start"
  icon={Carbon}
/>
<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  direction="bottom"
  align="center"
  tooltipText="Center"
  icon={Carbon}
/>
<TooltipIcon
  portalTooltip
  direction="bottom"
  align="end"
  tooltipText="End"
  icon={Carbon}
/>
```

### Inside a modal

When a tooltip icon is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), it is automatically portalled so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. Set `portalTooltip` to override this behavior.

```svelte
<script>

    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <TooltipIcon tooltipText="Top" direction="top" icon={Filter} />
    <TooltipIcon tooltipText="Right" direction="right" icon={Filter} />
    <TooltipIcon tooltipText="Bottom" direction="bottom" icon={Filter} />
    <TooltipIcon tooltipText="Left" direction="left" icon={Filter} />
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

## TreeView

### Basic

Create a basic tree view using the `nodes` prop. Each node needs a unique id and display text; icons, disabled state, and nested children are optional.

By default, only one node is selected at a time. For multiple selection, see Multi-select ([Node](#node), [Shallow](#shallow), [Deep](#deep)).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let activeId = "";
  let selectedIds = [];
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
    {
      id: 9,
      text: "Databases",
      nodes: [
        { id: 10, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for Elasticsearch" },
        { id: 11, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for Enterprise DB" },
        { id: 12, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for MongoDB" },
        { id: 13, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 14,
      text: "Integration",
      disabled: true,
      nodes: [{ id: 15, text: "IBM API Connect", disabled: true }],
    },
  ];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <TreeView
      labelText="Cloud Products"
      {nodes}
      bind:activeId
      bind:selectedIds
      on:select={({ detail }) => console.log("select", detail)}
      on:toggle={({ detail }) => console.log("toggle", detail)}
      on:focus={({ detail }) => console.log("focus", detail)}
    />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>Active node id: {activeId}</div>
    <div>Selected ids: {JSON.stringify(selectedIds)}</div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Compact

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TreeView
  hideLabel
  labelText="Cloud Products"
  nodes={[
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    { id: 1, text: "Analytics" },
    { id: 2, text: "Databases" },
  ]}
/>
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content instead of `labelText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TreeView
  labelText=""
  nodes={[
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    { id: 1, text: "Analytics" },
    { id: 2, text: "Databases" },
  ]}
>
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Cloud Products</strong>
</TreeView>
```

#### Custom (slot)

Customize node rendering using the default slot with the `let:node` directive. The node object provides:

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | The node id. |
| text | The node text. |
| expanded | True when the node is expanded. |
| leaf | True when the node does not have child nodes. |
| disabled | True when the node is disabled. |
| selected | True when the node is selected. |
| checked | True when the node is checked (`selectionMode="checkbox"`). |
| indeterminate | True when the node is partially checked (`selectionMode="checkbox"`). |

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedIds = [0, 7, 9];
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },

      id: 1,

      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
    {
      id: 9,
      text: "Databases",
      nodes: [
        { id: 10, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for Elasticsearch" },
        { id: 11, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for Enterprise DB" },
        { id: 12, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for MongoDB" },
        { id: 13, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 14,

<Stack gap={6}>
```

#### Checkbox

Set `selectionMode` to `"checkbox"` to render a checkbox on every node. Checking a branch checks its descendants, and a branch whose descendants are only partly checked renders indeterminate. Checkbox mode also works with [Virtualization](#virtualization).

Bind to `checkedIds` to read and set which nodes are checked. That is separate from `selectedIds`, which tracks row highlighting and is unused in checkbox mode. Bind to `indeterminateIds` to read which nodes are partially checked; it is derived from `checkedIds` and read-only, so writes are overwritten. Checkbox mode carries its own multi-selection, so [Multi-select](#multi-select) is ignored. Link nodes navigate instead of checking and render no checkbox.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let checkedIds = [3];
  let indeterminateIds = [];
  let expandedIds = [1, 2, 7];
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
  ];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <TreeView
      selectionMode="checkbox"
      labelText="Cloud Products"
      {nodes}
      bind:checkedIds
      bind:indeterminateIds
      bind:expandedIds
    />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>Checked ids: {JSON.stringify(checkedIds)}</div>
    <div>Indeterminate ids: {JSON.stringify(indeterminateIds)}</div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Inline editing

Use a `contenteditable` element in each tree view node to enable inline editing of node names. The editable region is wrapped in a container with `stopPropagation` to prevent tree node selection when editing.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RecursiveList, Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Edit from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Edit.svelte";

  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
    {
      id: 9,
      text: "Databases",
      nodes: [
        { id: 10, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for Elasticsearch" },
        { id: 11, text: "IBM Cloud Databases for MongoDB" },
      ],
    },
  ];

  function updateNodeText(id, text) {
    const findAndUpdate = (items) => {
      for (const item of items) {
        if (item.id === id) {
          item.text = text;
          return true;
        }
        if (item.nodes && findAndUpdate(item.nodes)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    };
    findAndUpdate(nodes);
    nodes = nodes;
  }

  function syncContenteditable(element, text) {
    element.textContent = text;
    return {
      update(text) {
        if (document.activeElement !== element) {
          element.textContent = text;
        }
      },
    };
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <TreeView labelText="Cloud Products" {nodes} let:node>
      <div on:click|stopPropagation on:keydown|stopPropagation role="none">
        <Stack
          orientation="horizontal"
          gap={2}
          tag="span"
          style="align-items: center; outline: none"
        >
          <span
            use:syncContenteditable={node.text}
            contenteditable={!node.disabled}
            on:input={(e) =>
              updateNodeText(node.id, e.currentTarget.textContent)}
            style:outline="none"
          ></span>
          <Edit aria-hidden="true" />
        </Stack>
      </div>
    </TreeView>
  </div>
  <RecursiveList {nodes} />
</Stack>
```

### Events

Use `on:select`, `on:toggle`, `on:check`, and `on:focus` for user-driven selection, expansion, checking, and focus. Each detail is the affected node after the gesture, with the same shape as the [Custom (slot)](#custom-slot) node. `on:check` fires only in `selectionMode="checkbox"`, when the checkbox itself is toggled; link nodes (which render no checkbox) fire `on:select` instead.

Use `on:toggle:change`, `on:select:change`, and `on:check:change` to track every expansion, selection, or check change from any source, including imperative methods and bound ids. Each detail includes the full set plus `added` and `removed` deltas (`on:check:change` also includes `indeterminateIds`). Aggregate events skip mount and no-op updates; bulk operations emit one event.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let treeview = null;
  let lastEvent = null;
  let lastToggleChange = null;
  let lastSelectChange = null;
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
  ];

  function logEvent(type, detail) {
    lastEvent = {
      type,
      id: detail.id,
      text: detail.text,
      expanded: detail.expanded,
      selected: detail.selected,
    };
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <Button on:click={() => treeview?.expandAll()}>Expand all</Button>
    <Button kind="secondary" on:click={() => treeview?.collapseAll()}>
      Collapse all
    </Button>
  </div>
  <div>
    <TreeView
      bind:this={treeview}
      multiselect
      labelText="Cloud Products"
      {nodes}
      on:select={({ detail }) => logEvent("select", detail)}
      on:toggle={({ detail }) => logEvent("toggle", detail)}
      on:focus={({ detail }) => logEvent("focus", detail)}
      on:toggle:change={({ detail }) => (lastToggleChange = detail)}
      on:select:change={({ detail }) => (lastSelectChange = detail)}
    />
  </div>
  {#if lastEvent}
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <div>Last node event: {lastEvent.type}</div>
      <div>Node: {lastEvent.text} (id: {lastEvent.id})</div>
      <div>detail.expanded: {lastEvent.expanded}</div>
      <div>detail.selected: {lastEvent.selected}</div>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  {#if lastToggleChange}
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <div>Last toggle:change</div>
      <div>expandedIds: {JSON.stringify(lastToggleChange.expandedIds)}</div>
      <div>added: {JSON.stringify(lastToggleChange.added)}</div>
      <div>removed: {JSON.stringify(lastToggleChange.removed)}</div>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  {#if lastSelectChange}
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <div>Last select:change</div>
      <div>selectedIds: {JSON.stringify(lastSelectChange.selectedIds)}</div>
      <div>added: {JSON.stringify(lastSelectChange.added)}</div>
      <div>removed: {JSON.stringify(lastSelectChange.removed)}</div>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</Stack>
```

### Multi-select

Set `multiselect` to allow more than one selected row; `multiselectMode` controls the unit each gesture applies to.

For a selection that persists parent and child state instead of highlighting rows, see [Checkbox](#checkbox).

#### Node

With the default `multiselectMode="node"`, each gesture applies to the clicked row only, not its children.

| Gesture | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Plain click | Replaces the selection with that row and sets the anchor used for the next range selection. |
| <kbd>CMD</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + click | Toggles that row's unit: deselect (remove the whole unit from the selection) if it is already selected, add it otherwise. Other selected rows stay selected. The anchor updates to the row you clicked. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + click | Replaces the selection with all visible rows from the anchor through the clicked row, in tree order (only rows under expanded parents count; collapsed branches are not included). If no anchor exists yet, behavior matches a plain click. Holding <kbd>Shift</kbd> together with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> or <kbd>CMD</kbd> still applies range selection, not per-row toggle. |

For selection that includes direct children or the full subtree on each gesture, see [Shallow](#shallow) and [Deep](#deep).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let activeId = 0;
  let selectedIds = [0];
  let expandedIds = [1];
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
  ];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <TreeView
      multiselect
      multiselectMode="node"
      labelText="Cloud Products (node scope)"
      {nodes}
      bind:activeId
      bind:selectedIds
      bind:expandedIds
    />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>Active node id: {activeId}</div>
    <div>Selected ids: {JSON.stringify(selectedIds)}</div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Shallow

With `multiselectMode="shallow"`, the same modifier keys apply, but each row acts as a **unit** of one parent plus its immediate non-disabled children (deeper descendants are not included).

| Gesture | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Plain click; <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> or <kbd>CMD</kbd> + click | Adds or removes that whole shallow set. Toggle removes every id in that set when the clicked row was already part of the selection. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + click | Walks the visible rows between anchor and target as in [node mode](#node), then expands each of those rows to its shallow set and merges the results in order (duplicates omitted). |

```svelte
<script>
```

#### Deep

With `multiselectMode="deep"`, each row's unit is that node plus **all** non-disabled descendants recursively (full subtree). Disabled nodes are skipped, and subtrees under a disabled node are not traversed.

| Gesture | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Plain click; <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> or <kbd>CMD</kbd> + click | Uses that deep expansion for replace and toggle, respectively. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + click | Takes the visible range between anchor and target and unions each row's deep expansion the same way as in shallow mode. |

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TreeView } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let activeId = 0;
  let selectedIds = [0];
  let expandedIds = [1, 2];
  let nodes = [
    { id: 0, text: "AI / Machine learning" },
    {
      id: 1,
      text: "Analytics",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 2,
          text: "IBM Analytics Engine",
          nodes: [
            { id: 3, text: "Apache Spark" },
            { id: 4, text: "Hadoop" },
          ],
        },
        { id: 5, text: "IBM Cloud SQL Query" },
        { id: 6, text: "IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 7,
      text: "Blockchain",
      nodes: [{ id: 8, text: "IBM Blockchain Platform" }],
    },
  ];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <div>
    <TreeView
      multiselect
      multiselectMode="deep"
      labelText="Cloud Products (deep scope)"
      {nodes}
      bind:activeId
      bind:selectedIds
      bind:expandedIds
    />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>Active node id: {activeId}</div>
    <div>Selected ids: {JSON.stringify(selectedIds)}</div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Expand and collapse
