### Profile menu

Use `ProfileMenu` for an account menu in the header.

#### Fallback avatar

When the `avatar` slot is empty, a default [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar) renders. The menu closes on outside click and <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Content,
    Header,
    HeaderUtilities,
    ProfileMenu,
    ProfileMenuDivider,
    ProfileMenuHeader,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Logout from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Logout.svelte";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Carbon Svelte">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <ProfileMenu iconDescription="Profile">
      <ProfileMenuHeader
        name="Richard Hendricks"
        username="rhendricks"
        href="/"
      />
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Settings</ProfileMenuItem>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Privacy</ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem icon={Logout} on:click={() => {}}>
          Log out
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
    </ProfileMenu>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <h1>Welcome</h1>
</Content>
```

From the trigger, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> open the menu and move focus to the first or last `ProfileMenuItem`. Once inside, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between items (wrapping at either end), and <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last item.

#### Events

`ProfileMenu` dispatches `open` and `close` as the menu toggles. Set `preventCloseOnClickOutside` to keep the menu open when the user clicks elsewhere on the page, and `transition` (for example `{ duration: 200 }`) to animate the menu open and closed -- by default it does not animate.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProfileMenu, ProfileMenuList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProfileMenu
  bind:isOpen
  preventCloseOnClickOutside
  on:open={() => console.log("opened")}
  on:close={() => console.log("closed")}
>
  <ProfileMenuList>...</ProfileMenuList>
</ProfileMenu>
```

### Account switcher

Use `HeaderSwitcher` in place of the header logo to let users switch between accounts or workspaces. The trigger shows the active account name; the chevron rotates to indicate the open state.

_Prototype -- pending review._

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderSwitcher,
    ProfileMenuDivider,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";

  const workspaces = [
    { id: "acme", name: "Acme Corp" },
    { id: "globex", name: "Globex Industries" },
    { id: "initech", name: "Initech" },
    {
      id: "umbrella",
      name: "Umbrella Regional Distribution & Logistics Cooperative",
    },
  ];

  let activeId = "acme";
  let isOpen = false;

  $: active = workspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === activeId);
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderSwitcher text={active.name} bind:isOpen>
    <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
      <UserAvatar name={active.name} backgroundColor="auto" size="sm" />
    </svelte:fragment>
    <ProfileMenuList>
      {#each workspaces as workspace (workspace.id)}
        <ProfileMenuItem
          icon={workspace.id === activeId ? Checkmark : undefined}
          on:click={() => {
            activeId = workspace.id;
            isOpen = false;
          }}
        >
          <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
            <UserAvatar
              name={workspace.name}
              backgroundColor="auto"
              size="sm"
            />
          </svelte:fragment>
          {workspace.name}
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      {/each}
    </ProfileMenuList>
    <ProfileMenuDivider />
    <ProfileMenuList>
      <ProfileMenuItem icon={Add}>Create workspace</ProfileMenuItem>
    </ProfileMenuList>
  </HeaderSwitcher>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>{active.name}</h1>
        <p>Switch workspaces from the trigger in the header above.</p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

Compose the dropdown from [`ProfileMenuList`](#profile-menu) and `ProfileMenuItem`, as shown above. Pass an `icon` to `ProfileMenuItem` to mark the active account, and use its `avatar` slot for a leading avatar. The label truncates with an ellipsis when the name overflows the menu width, as shown by the last item.

The trigger's `text` truncates with an ellipsis past `maxWidth`, defaulting to `"10rem"`, so a long account name does not push the header wider. Set `maxWidth` to a different CSS length, or to `"none"` to let the trigger grow with the text instead.

<kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> and <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> from the trigger open the menu and move focus to the first or last item. Once inside, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between items (wrapping at either end), <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last item, and <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

#### No avatar

Neither `HeaderSwitcher` nor `ProfileMenuItem` renders a default avatar -- the `avatar` slot is empty unless you provide one. Omit it on both for a text-only trigger and menu.

```svelte
<script>

    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderSwitcher,

    ProfileMenuList,
    Row,

  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";

  const accounts = [
    { id: "acme", name: "Acme Corp" },
    { id: "globex", name: "Globex Industries" },
    { id: "initech", name: "Initech" },
  ];

  let activeId = "acme";
  let isOpen = false;

  $: active = accounts.find((account) => account.id === activeId);
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderSwitcher text={active.name} bind:isOpen>
    <ProfileMenuList>
      {#each accounts as account (account.id)}
        <ProfileMenuItem
          icon={account.id === activeId ? Checkmark : undefined}
          on:click={() => {
            activeId = account.id;
            isOpen = false;
          }}
        >
          {account.name}
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      {/each}
    </ProfileMenuList>
  </HeaderSwitcher>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>{active.name}</h1>
        <p>
          No avatar slot on the trigger or the items -- a text-only switcher.
        </p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Icon avatar

Use the `avatar` slot to render a plain icon instead of a `UserAvatar`, for example a fixed brand icon rather than a per-account photo.

```svelte
<script>

    { id: "globex", name: "Globex Industries" },

</script>

<Header>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderSwitcher text={active.name}>
    <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
      <Enterprise size={16} />
    </svelte:fragment>
    <ProfileMenuList>
      {#each workspaces as workspace (workspace.id)}
        <ProfileMenuItem
          icon={workspace.id === activeId ? Checkmark : undefined}
          on:click={() => (activeId = workspace.id)}
        >
          <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
            <UserAvatar
              name={workspace.name}
              backgroundColor="auto"
              size="sm"
            />
          </svelte:fragment>
          {workspace.name}
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      {/each}
    </ProfileMenuList>
  </HeaderSwitcher>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>{active.name}</h1>
        <p>
          A plain icon in the <code>avatar</code> slot replaces the per-workspace
          photo with a fixed brand icon.
        </p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Events

`HeaderSwitcher` dispatches `open` and `close` as the menu toggles, with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"toggle"`, `"outside-click"`, or `"escape-key"` (`close` only):

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderSwitcher, ProfileMenuList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderSwitcher
  bind:isOpen
  on:open={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
  on:close={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
>
  <ProfileMenuList>...</ProfileMenuList>
</HeaderSwitcher>
```

### Integrations

The UI Shell coordinates body scroll locking and notifications with other components.

#### Modal

Opening a modal while the mobile side nav overlay is also open keeps body scroll locked until both close. The lock is ref-counted across components.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    Modal,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
  let open = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
    </SideNavMenu>
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Modal
  bind:open
  modalHeading="Create cluster"
  primaryButtonText="Create"
  secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
  on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  on:submit={() => (open = false)}
>
  <p>
    The body scroll lock is ref-counted, so opening this modal while the side
    nav overlay is also open keeps the page locked until both are closed.
  </p>
</Modal>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <Stack gap={6}>
          <h1>Clusters</h1>
          <Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create cluster</Button>
        </Stack>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Toast notification

Integrate toasts with the UI Shell. This example triggers a toast, which appears in the top right corner, below the header.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    NotificationQueue,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let queue;
  let queuePosition = "top-right";

  const triggerToast = (position) => {
    queuePosition = position;
    queue.add({
      kind: "success",
      title: "Cluster created",
      subtitle: "Your Kubernetes cluster is now provisioning.",
      timeout: 5000,
    });
  };
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<NotificationQueue bind:this={queue} position={queuePosition} />

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <Stack gap={6}>
          <h1>Clusters</h1>
          <p>
            Click the buttons below to trigger toast notifications in different
            positions.
          </p>
          <ButtonSet>
            <Button on:click={() => triggerToast("top-right")}>
              Top right
            </Button>
            <Button on:click={() => triggerToast("bottom-right")}>
              Bottom right
            </Button>
          </ButtonSet>
        </Stack>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

### Classic theme

Before version 0.105.0, the UI Shell defaulted to a mixed theme: **Gray 100** header and **White** side navigation. Now it follows the active theme (`white`, `g10`, `g80`, `g90`, `g100`).

Set `theme="classic"` on both the header and side nav for the classic look: **Gray 100** header and **White** side navigation, independent of the global theme. The classic theme requires **carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css** because it relies on CSS custom properties.

```css
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css";
```

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderAction,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    HeaderPanelDivider,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
  let isOpen = false;
</script>

<Header
  companyName="IBM"
  platformName="Cloud"
  theme="classic"
  bind:isSideNavOpen
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderAction bind:isOpen>
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelDivider>Switch product</HeaderPanelDivider>
        <HeaderPanelLink href="/cloud">Cloud console</HeaderPanelLink>
        <HeaderPanelDivider>Resources</HeaderPanelDivider>
        <HeaderPanelLink href="/docs">Documentation</HeaderPanelLink>
        <HeaderPanelLink href="/status">Status page</HeaderPanelLink>
        <HeaderPanelLink href="/community">Community</HeaderPanelLink>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<SideNav theme="classic" bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink href="/settings" text="Account settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

### Component API

#### `Header` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isSideNavOpen` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the side nav. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML anchor element. | `null` |
| `expandedByDefault` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to hide the side nav by default | `true` |
| `uiShellAriaLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the header. | _undefined_ |
| `href` | `string` | Specify the `href` attribute. | _undefined_ |
| `companyName` | `string` | Specify the company name.<br /><br />Alternatively, use the named slot "company". | _undefined_ |
| `platformName` | `string` | Specify the platform name.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "platform". | `""` |
| `persistentHamburgerMenu` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to persist the hamburger menu | `false` |
| `expansionBreakpoint` | `number` | The window width (px) at which the SideNav is expanded and the hamburger menu is hidden.<br />1056 represents the "large" breakpoint in pixels from the Carbon Design System:<br />- small: 320<br />- medium: 672<br />- large: 1056<br />- x-large: 1312<br />- max: 1584. | `1056` |
| `iconMenu` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the closed state. | `Menu` |
| `iconClose` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the opened state. | `Close` |
| `ariaLabelMenu` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the hamburger menu.<br />Defaults to "Open menu" or "Close menu" based on `isSideNavOpen` state. | _undefined_ |
| `theme` | `"classic" \| undefined` | Set to `"classic"` for the mixed UI Shell theme (Gray 100 header).<br />Use with `SideNav` `theme="classic"` (White side nav).<br />Requires `carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css`. | _undefined_ |

#### `HeaderSearch` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string` | Specify the search input value. | `""` |
| `active` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to activate and focus the search bar. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `selectedResultIndex` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the selected result index. | `0` |
| `results` | `ReadonlyArray<Result>` | Render a list of search results. | `[]` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the search trigger. | `IconSearch` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Specify the `placeholder` attribute of the search input. | `"Search..."` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the text for the assistive label associated with the search input. | `"Search"` |
| `closeButtonLabelText` | `string` | Specify the label for the clear button. | `"Clear search input"` |
| `shouldFilter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to filter `menu`-slot items by the search value using fuzzy<br />matching. Requires the `menu` slot; ignored when using the `results` prop. | `true` |
| `match` | `(text: string, query: string) => { matched: boolean; indices?: number[] }` | Override how the search value is matched against each `menu`-slot item's<br />`text`. Receives the item `text` and the current search value, and returns<br />whether the item `matched` along with the `indices` of characters to<br />highlight. Defaults to fuzzy matching. Requires the `menu` slot. | `fuzzyMatch` |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a skeleton menu while results are loading.<br />Override the placeholder rows with the `loading` slot. Requires the<br />`menu` slot. | `false` |
| `skeletonCount` | `number` | Number of skeleton rows while `loading`. Requires the `menu` slot. | `4` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Row density for the `menu` slot. Result text stays flush with the header<br />input; smaller sizes shorten rows to fit more results. | `"sm"` |

| `maxWidth` | `number \| string` | Specify the maximum width of `text` before it truncates with an ellipsis.<br />A number is treated as pixels; a string is used as a CSS length.<br />Set to `"none"` to let the trigger grow with the text. | `"10rem"` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the accessible label for the trigger button.<br />Only used when `text` is not set. | `"Switch account"` |
| `transition` | `false \| import("svelte/transition").SlideParams` | Customize the menu slide transition (for example, `{ duration: 200 }`).<br />By default, the menu does not animate. | `false` |
| `preventCloseOnClickOutside` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to prevent the menu from closing when clicking outside | `false` |

## UnorderedList

### Basic

Create a basic unordered list with list item components. For tree-structured data, consider [RecursiveList](/components/RecursiveList).

```svelte
<script>
  import { ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>Unordered list item</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list item</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list item</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### With links

Add links to list items by wrapping them in link components.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">Unordered list item</Link>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">Unordered list item</Link>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">Unordered list item</Link>
  </ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### Nested lists

Create hierarchical lists by setting `nested` on a child unordered list component.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>
    Unordered list level 1
    <UnorderedList nested>
      <ListItem>Unordered list level 2</ListItem>
      <ListItem>
        Unordered list level 3
        <UnorderedList nested>
          <ListItem>Unordered list level 3</ListItem>
          <ListItem>Unordered list level 3</ListItem>
        </UnorderedList>
      </ListItem>
    </UnorderedList>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list level 1</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list level 1</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### Expressive styles

Use Carbon's expressive typesetting with `expressive`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList expressive>
  <ListItem><Link size="lg" href="#">Unordered list item</Link></ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list item</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Unordered list item</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

---

### Component API

#### `UnorderedList` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nested` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the nested variant | `false` |
| `expressive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting | `false` |

#### `UnorderedList` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `UnorderedList` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

`UnorderedList` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul` element.

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

## UserAvatar

### Content

The avatar renders the first available of custom slotted content, an image, a custom icon, initials, or the default user icon. It is designed for the UI Shell [profile menu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu).

#### Fallback icon

Render the avatar without any content to show the default user icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar />
```

#### Initials

Set `name` to derive the user's initials. The first character of each word is used, capped at two.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Monica" />
<UserAvatar name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

Set `initials` to override the derived initials while keeping `name` for display purposes such as tooltips.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard J. Hendricks"
  initials="RH"
  tooltipText="Richard J. Hendricks"
/>
```

#### Custom icon

Set `icon` to render a custom icon instead of the default user icon, such as an icon from [carbon-icons-svelte](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-icons-svelte).

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
  import Group from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Group.svelte";
  import Password from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Password.svelte";
  import UserAvatarFilledAlt from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/UserAvatarFilledAlt.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar icon={UserAvatarFilledAlt} />
<UserAvatar icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar icon={Password} backgroundColor="teal" />
<UserAvatar icon={Group} backgroundColor="cool-gray" />
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar size="sm" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="md" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="lg" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="xl" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
```

#### Custom content

Use the default slot to render arbitrary content, such as a status badge, instead of the computed image, icon, or initials. Slotted content takes priority over `image`, `icon`, and `initials`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cyan">99+</UserAvatar>
```

### Image

Set `image` to render a photo. Provide `imageDescription` for the alternative text. The image fills the circle (`object-fit: cover`) and takes priority over the icon and initials.

If the image fails to load, the avatar falls back to the icon or initials and dispatches `image:error`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
```

#### Image attributes

Pass HTML attributes to the image with `imageAttributes`. Use this for values such as `loading`, `srcset`, or `referrerPolicy`. Rest props stay on the host element; `image` and `imageDescription` still set `src` and `alt`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
  imageAttributes={{ loading: "lazy" }}
/>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to one of `"sm"`, `"md"` (default), `"lg"`, or `"xl"`. The size applies to any content; the image fills the frame at every size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="sm"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="md"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="lg"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
```

### Background colors

Set `backgroundColor` to choose the color rendered behind the initials or icon. The default is `"gray"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="red" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="magenta" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="purple" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="blue" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cyan" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="teal" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="green" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cool-gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="warm-gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

#### Automatic background color

Set `backgroundColor` to `"auto"` to pick a color from `name` (or `initials`). The name is hashed into one of the palette swatches. The same name always gets the same color.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Dinesh Chugtai" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Bertram Gilfoyle" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Jared Dunn" />
```

### Clickable avatar

Render the avatar as an interactive element instead of a static `span` -- a `button` for a custom control, or an anchor for a link.

#### Interactive

Set `interactive` to render a `button` instead of a `span` when the avatar is a clickable control, such as a custom profile menu trigger. The button receives a focus ring. `name` is used as the accessible name when `aria-label` is not set.

Do not set `interactive` when slotting the avatar into [ProfileMenu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu) -- that component already wraps the avatar in a labelled trigger button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar interactive name="Richard Hendricks" backgroundColor="purple" />
```

#### Link

Set `href` to render an anchor, for example a profile page link. `href` takes priority over `interactive`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar href="/profile" name="Richard Hendricks" backgroundColor="blue" />
```

### Tooltip

Set `tooltipText` to show the display name on hover or focus. The tooltip closes on <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

Setting `tooltipText` wraps the avatar in a focusable button. Do not combine it with `interactive` or `href`, and do not set it when slotting the avatar into the `ProfileMenu` trigger.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Richard Hendricks" tooltipText="Richard Hendricks" />
```

#### Position

Set `direction` to `"top"` or `"bottom"` to position the tooltip relative to the avatar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  direction="top"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  direction="bottom"
/>
```

#### Alignment

Set `align` to `"start"`, `"center"`, or `"end"` to align the tooltip relative to the avatar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="start"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="center"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="end"
/>
```

#### Inline tooltip

By default, the tooltip renders in a floating portal so it is not clipped by the avatar's circular frame or an `overflow: hidden` container. Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to render the tooltip inline.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  portalTooltip={false}
/>
```

#### Inside a modal

The floating portal keeps the tooltip from being clipped by the modal's overflow and z-index stacking.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, Portal, UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    size="sm"
    modalHeading="UserAvatar in modal"
    primaryButtonText="Done"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <UserAvatar
      name="Richard Hendricks"
      tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
      direction="bottom"
    />
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

### Use within ProfileMenu

Slot the avatar into [ProfileMenu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu) for the header trigger and the profile header. Use `size="md"` for the trigger and `size="lg"` for the header to match the menu frame. Leave `interactive`, `href`, and `tooltipText` unset on the slotted avatar so the menu owns focus and labelling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar size="md" name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

---

### Component API

#### `UserAvatar` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLSpanElement \| HTMLElement` | Obtain a reference to the avatar HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the avatar.<br />Defaults to `"md"`, or to the `size` of a parent `UserAvatarGroup`. | _undefined_ |
| `backgroundColor` | `"auto" \| "red" \| "magenta" \| "purple" \| "blue" \| "cyan" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "gray" \| "cool-gray" \| "warm-gray"` | Specify the background color rendered behind the initials or icon.<br />Set to `"auto"` to pick a stable color from `name` (or `initials`). | `"gray"` |
| `name` | `string` | Specify the user's full name. Initials are derived from the name when `initials` is not set. | _undefined_ |
| `initials` | `string` | Specify the initials to display. Takes priority over initials derived from `name`. | _undefined_ |
| `image` | `string` | Specify an image source to render a photo.<br />Takes priority over the icon and initials.<br />If the image fails to load, the avatar falls back to the icon or initials<br />and dispatches `image:error`. | _undefined_ |
| `imageDescription` | `string` | Specify alternative text for the image. | _undefined_ |
| `imageAttributes` | `Record<string, string>` | Pass additional attributes through to the image element<br />(for example `loading`, `srcset`, or `referrerPolicy`).<br />Does not replace `image` or `imageDescription`. Rest props stay on the host. | _undefined_ |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render. Falls back to a default user icon. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipText` | `string` | Specify the tooltip text. When set, the avatar is wrapped in a tooltip.<br />Do not combine with `interactive` or `href` -- the tooltip trigger is already<br />focusable, and nesting an interactive avatar inside it is invalid. | _undefined_ |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the avatar. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the avatar. | `"bottom"` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to render the tooltip inline instead of in a floating portal.<br />The portal prevents the tooltip from being clipped by the avatar's `overflow: hidden`<br />frame or an `overflow: hidden` container such as a `Modal`. | `true` |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a `button` element instead of a `span`.<br />Use when the avatar is a clickable control (for example, a custom profile menu<br />trigger). Prefer this over attaching `on:click` to a non-interactive `span`.<br />Ignored when `href` is set. | `false` |
| `href` | `string` | Set an `href` to render an anchor element instead of a `span`.<br />Takes priority over `interactive`. | _undefined_ |

#### `UserAvatar` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `UserAvatar` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `UserAvatar` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:image:error` | `null` | Dispatched when the `image` URL fails to load. The avatar then falls back to the icon or initials. |

#### `UserAvatar` $$restProps

`UserAvatar` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span | button | a` element.


## UserAvatarGroup

### Basic

Put [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar) children inside the group. The default layout stacks them with a slight overlap. A ring keeps the circles distinct, and hover brings an avatar to the front. Set `tooltipText` on each avatar to show the name on hover or focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

### Overflow

Set `max` to limit how many avatars show. Everyone else goes into a "+N" overflow avatar. Hover it for the hidden names. Counts above 99 show as `99+` so the label fits the circle.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup max={3}>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Bertram Gilfoyle"
    tooltipText="Bertram Gilfoyle"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Jared Dunn"
    tooltipText="Jared Dunn"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Erlich Bachman"
    tooltipText="Erlich Bachman"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

Set `max` to `0` to show every avatar without an overflow.

#### Large groups

Every slotted avatar still mounts; CSS hides the ones past `max`. For large lists, render only the faces you need and set `total` to the real headcount so the "+N" chip gets the right number without mounting hundreds of nodes. Set `overflowTooltipText` when the hidden people are not slotted, since the default tooltip only lists mounted `name` values.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup
  max={3}
  total={250}
  overflowTooltipText="Gilfoyle, Jared, Erlich, and 244 others"
>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

### Spacing

Leave `gap` unset for the default overlapping layout. Set `gap` to a positive value to space the avatars apart, or to a negative length string to tighten the overlap.

#### Scale

Set `gap` to a Carbon layout scale from `0` to `13`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup gap={2}>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup gap={6}>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

#### Custom length

Set `gap` to any CSS length string for spacing off the scale.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup gap="24px">
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />

    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

#### Tighter overlap

Set `gap` to a negative length string to overlap the avatars by that amount, tighter than the default stack.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup gap="-1rem">
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />

    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

#### Stack order

By default, the last avatar paints on top. Set `stackOrder="first"` to keep the first avatar most prominent instead.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup stackOrder="first">
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

### Icons

Set `icon` on each avatar to render a custom icon, such as one from [carbon-icons-svelte](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-icons-svelte), instead of a photo or initials.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
  import Group from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Group.svelte";
  import Password from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Password.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup>
  <UserAvatar icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" tooltipText="Bot" />
  <UserAvatar icon={Password} backgroundColor="teal" tooltipText="Password" />
  <UserAvatar icon={Group} backgroundColor="cool-gray" tooltipText="Group" />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

### Background colors

Every example on this page sets `backgroundColor="auto"` on each `UserAvatar`, which hashes a stable color from `name` (or `initials`) -- the same name always gets the same color. See [UserAvatar's background colors section](/components/UserAvatar#background-colors) for the full palette and the other `backgroundColor` values.

#### Exported `getAvatarBackgroundColor` utility

Import `getAvatarBackgroundColor` to compute the same color outside a `UserAvatar`, for example to match a name's avatar color in a legend or a custom rendering.

```html
<script context="module">
  import { getAvatarBackgroundColor } from "carbon-components-svelte/src/utils/avatarColor.js";

  getAvatarBackgroundColor("Richard Hendricks"); // "teal"
</script>
```

### Tooltips

Set `tooltipText` on each avatar to show its name on hover or focus, the same as a standalone [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar#tooltip). Within a group, only one avatar's tooltip stays open at a time -- hovering a new avatar closes the previous one immediately, whether it's a slotted avatar or the "+N" overflow chip.

Moving the pointer directly from one avatar to a neighbor whose tooltip is already open skips the usual enter delay, so the tooltip swaps in immediately instead of waiting again. Hover across the avatars in the examples above to feel this.

---

### Component API

#### `UserAvatarGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | `number` | Specify the maximum number of avatars to show before collapsing the rest<br />into a "+N" overflow avatar. Set to `0` to show every avatar. | `5` |
| `total` | `number` | Specify the total number of people represented. Defaults to the number of<br />slotted avatars. Set this when you render only a subset (large groups) so<br />the overflow count stays right without mounting every avatar. | _undefined_ |
| `gap` | `import("../Stack/Stack.svelte").StackScale \| string` | Specify the spacing between avatars. Leave unset for the default<br />overlapping (stacked) layout. A positive value spaces the avatars apart,<br />accepting a Carbon layout scale (`0`-`13`) or a CSS length string. A<br />negative length string (for example `"-1rem"`) overlaps them by that<br />amount. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the avatars. Applies to slotted avatars without their<br />own `size`, and to the "+N" overflow chip. | `"md"` |
| `stackOrder` | `"last" \| "first"` | Specify which end of the stack renders on top when avatars overlap.<br />`"last"` matches the default browser paint order (and most avatar<br />stacks). `"first"` keeps the first avatar most prominent instead. | `"last"` |
| `overflowTooltipText` | `string` | Specify the tooltip text for the "+N" overflow avatar. Defaults to a<br />comma-separated list of hidden slotted `name` values. Set this when using<br />`total` for people who are not mounted. | _undefined_ |

#### `UserAvatarGroup` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `UserAvatarGroup` $$restProps

`UserAvatarGroup` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.
